66486.recognize_zh: 兩顆中大型細胞的細胞核呈雙葉、中央凹陷的「蘋果核／蝴蝶形」(bilobed, apple-core nucleus)，細胞質少且顆粒不明顯，配合臨床極高白血球數，應想到急性前骨髓細胞白血病 (APL)，特別是低顆粒型 (microgranular variant)。
features: Two medium-to-large atypical cells, roughly 1.5–2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Nucleus deeply folded to bilobed with a central indentation, giving an apple-core/butterfly contour
Moderately fine chromatin; nucleoli not clearly discernible at this magnification
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with inconspicuous fine granules; no Auer rods or faggot cells seen in this field
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytic change, likely drying artifact); platelets not evident
66486.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two atypical mononuclear cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. The nuclei are markedly folded to bilobed with a central cleft, imparting a characteristic apple-core (butterfly) configuration, and the cytoplasm is scant, basophilic and hypogranular. No Auer rods or bundles of Auer rods are identified in this field, and platelets are not seen. In the context of marked leukocytosis, these findings are suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypogranular (microgranular) variant; urgent coagulation studies and confirmation of PML::RARA are recommended.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei with grey-blue cytoplasm and fine vacuoles, are MPO weak/negative and nonspecific esterase positive, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO positive and typically CD34/HLA-DR negative.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with condensed chromatin and agranular cytoplasm, and lack MPO positivity.
Hairy cells have oval to bean-shaped nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm bearing circumferential hairy projections, not bilobed nuclei with basophilic granular cytoplasm.

66422.recognize_zh: 乳房粗針切片（B）為瀰漫浸潤的單一型小至中型細胞，免疫染色 CD20 強陽性（C）、BRAF V600E（D）、cyclin D1（E）、TRAP（F）陽性而 CD5 陰性（G），流式 CD103+/CD25+（H–I），這組合指向毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia），而非小葉癌。
features: Panel A: mammogram with a dense mass (circled)
Panel B: core biopsy with diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small to medium cells surrounding ducts, without gland formation
Panel C: strong diffuse membranous CD20 positivity in the infiltrate, sparing ducts and vessels
Panels D-F: tumor cells positive for BRAF (VE1), weak nuclear cyclin D1 and granular cytoplasmic TRAP
Panel G: CD5 highlights only scattered background T cells
Panels H-J: flow cytometry shows a CD20-bright, CD103+ and CD25+ B-cell population with light-chain analysis
66422.describe_en: Mammography demonstrates a circumscribed dense breast mass. The core biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized mononuclear cells with periductal and diffuse stromal infiltration and no epithelial differentiation. By immunohistochemistry the infiltrate is strongly CD20 positive, BRAF V600E (VE1) positive, weakly cyclin D1 positive and TRAP positive, while CD5 stains only scattered T cells. Flow cytometry identifies CD20-bright B cells co-expressing CD103 and CD25. Findings are consistent with extramedullary involvement of the breast by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lobular carcinoma shows single-file discohesive cells that are cytokeratin positive, often ER/PR positive and E-cadherin negative, whereas these cells are cytokeratin negative and CD20 positive.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL variant lacks CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E, whereas this infiltrate is CD25+ and BRAF VE1 positive.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5 positive with strong cyclin D1 and SOX11 and is CD103/CD25 negative.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of breast
ddx.vs: MZL is CD103/CD25 negative, BRAF VE1 negative and cyclin D1 negative, often with lymphoepithelial lesions and plasmacytic differentiation.

66422.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, BRAF, cyclin D1, TRAP, CD5; flow

66230.recognize_zh: 三張流式散點圖：綠色 P2 族群為 cyVS38c 強陽、CD45 陰性至弱陽；該族群 CD56 陽性、CD19 陰性，且細胞質輕鏈集中在 kappa 陽性象限（Q4）、lambda 陰性，代表單株性（kappa 限制）且表型異常的漿細胞，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Flow cytometry dot plots (non-morphologic figure), three panels
Panel 1: bright cytoplasmic VS38c (CD38 surrogate) population (green, P2) that is CD45 negative to dim, separated from CD45-bright orange events
Panel 2 (P3-gated): plasma cells are CD56 positive and CD19 negative (aberrant phenotype)
Panel 3 (P3-gated): cytoplasmic kappa positive with lambda negative, falling mainly in the kappa quadrant (Q4), indicating light chain restriction
66230.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis identifies a distinct plasma cell population with bright cytoplasmic VS38c expression and negative to dim CD45. Gated plasma cells are CD19-negative and CD56-positive, an aberrant phenotype, and show cytoplasmic kappa light chain restriction with no lambda expression. These findings demonstrate a monotypic, phenotypically abnormal plasma cell population consistent with plasma cell myeloma (in this case, involving CSF).

ddx.vs: Normal plasma cells are CD19-positive, CD56-negative, often CD45-positive, and show a mixed kappa:lambda distribution rather than single light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: The clonal plasma cells in LPL/MZL typically retain CD19 and CD45, lack CD56, and are accompanied by a light chain–restricted CD19+/CD20+ B-cell population.
Immunophenotype overlaps (CD38/CD138+, CD19−, CD45 dim); distinction depends on clinical context, EBER, MYC status and absence of myeloma-defining events.

66166.recognize_zh: 低倍（4x）TRAP 染色的骨髓切片，骨小梁之間散布許多成群、斑塊狀的深棕色陽性區域，對應 Gaucher 細胞的間質性浸潤；其餘造血組織呈藍色陰性。
features: Low-power trephine core with thin bony trabeculae
Multifocal patchy and confluent clusters of brown TRAP-positive cells throughout the intertrabecular spaces
Intervening TRAP-negative hematopoietic marrow with blue counterstain
Positive clusters distributed interstitially rather than along bone surfaces
Individual cell morphology not resolvable at 4x
66166.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy stained for tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase shows multifocal interstitial clusters and sheets of TRAP-positive cells distributed throughout the intertrabecular marrow, separated by TRAP-negative hematopoietic tissue. The positive cells are not confined to bone surfaces, arguing against osteoclasts. Cytologic detail is not assessable at this magnification. In correlation with H&E and PAS morphology, findings are consistent with extensive Gaucher cell infiltration.

ddx.vs: HCL shows a diffuse interstitial TRAP-positive infiltrate of small monotonous cells with fried-egg halos and reticulin fibrosis, confirmed by CD20, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Osteoclasts are TRAP positive but line trabecular surfaces with associated bone remodeling rather than forming interstitial sheets.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells may be TRAP positive and require assessment of the underlying marrow disease and glucocerebrosidase activity.

65974.recognize_zh: 三顆嗜中性球細胞質邊緣各有淡藍色的類 Döhle 包涵體（箭頭），且不伴毒性顆粒；背景血小板數量少但體積大，大小可達紅血球一半以上，符合 MYH9 相關疾病的巨大血小板合併類 Döhle 包涵體。
features: Neutrophils with small, pale blue, peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions (Döhle-like bodies, arrows)
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal without toxic granulation or vacuolation
Large platelets, some approaching half the diameter of red cells, with granular purple cytoplasm
Platelets appear sparse across the main field, consistent with thrombocytopenia
Normochromic, normocytic red cells in a dense monolayer
65974.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells with sparse platelets, several of which are large. Neutrophils contain small, pale blue cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery (arrows), resembling Döhle bodies, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolation. In a patient with thrombocytopenia and hearing loss, the combination of macrothrombocytopenia and Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions is consistent with an MYH9-related disorder; immunofluorescence for NMMHC-IIA aggregates or MYH9 sequencing confirms the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation and vacuolation with a normal platelet size, whereas MYH9 inclusions occur in otherwise normal neutrophils with giant platelets.
Bernard-Soulier shows giant platelets but no neutrophil inclusions, with absent ristocetin aggregation and reduced GPIb-IX-V on flow cytometry.
ITP has mildly enlarged platelets without neutrophil inclusions and lacks a family history, hearing loss, or MYH9 variant.
Gray platelet syndrome has large pale agranular platelets and no neutrophil inclusions.

64950.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：足踝上方皮膚乾燥、有細紋，可見一個小型、邊界清楚的黑色結痂/壞死性潰瘍，周圍呈發亮的淡色邊緣；此外觀本身不具特異性，需結合 LPL 與冷凝球蛋白血症病史，考慮血管炎或缺血性皮膚病灶。
features: Clinical photograph of the lower leg just above the ankle
Single small, well-demarcated ulcer covered by a black necrotic eschar
Surrounding thin, shiny, pale rim of epidermis without marked erythema in this image
Background skin is dry and xerotic with fine scaling
No palpable purpura or livedo visible in this field; morphology is nonspecific
64950.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the distal lower leg shows a small, sharply demarcated ulcer covered by black necrotic eschar with a thin shiny perilesional rim, on a background of dry, finely scaling skin. No surrounding purpura or livedo reticularis is evident in this image. The lesion is nonspecific; in a patient with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma and cryoglobulins it is compatible with a cryoglobulinemic or hyperviscosity-related ischemic/vasculitic skin ulcer, and biopsy would be needed to separate vasculitis, vessel-occlusive cryoglobulin deposition or specific cutaneous lymphoma infiltration.

ddx.vs: Specific infiltration typically forms papules, plaques or nodules and shows a dermal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate on biopsy rather than necrotic eschar.
Stasis ulcers are shallow, on the medial malleolus, with hemosiderin hyperpigmentation and lipodermatosclerosis.
Arterial ulcers are punched-out over pressure points with absent pulses and hairless atrophic skin, without cryoglobulin deposits.
Calciphylaxis shows retiform purpura evolving to eschar, typically in renal failure, with vascular calcification on biopsy.

65654.recognize_zh: 視野中央的嗜中性球核分成約 5–6 葉，各葉以細絲相連、染色質粗濃，細胞大小與正常嗜中性球相近；只要出現 ≥6 葉或 ≥5 葉比例增加，即為分葉過多（hypersegmentation）。
features: Single mature neutrophil of normal size
Nucleus with about 5-6 discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; no Döhle bodies or vacuoles evident
Background red cells largely normocytic with scattered platelets
65654.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil of normal size with a nucleus divided into approximately five to six lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments. The cytoplasm contains fine neutrophilic granules without obvious toxic granulation or vacuolization. Red cells appear largely normocytic without obvious macro-ovalocytes in this field, and platelets are present. Findings show neutrophil hypersegmentation; correlation with vitamin B12 and folate levels and a differential count of lobe numbers is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows hypersegmented neutrophils together with macro-ovalocytes and often pancytopenia, which are not evident in this field.
The hereditary form is a benign autosomal dominant trait with hypersegmentation in most neutrophils and normal vitamin levels, requiring family studies.
Morphology is identical, so medication history is required to separate drug-induced hypersegmentation.

ddx.dx: Overlapping bands or two superimposed neutrophils
ddx.vs: Superimposed cells show two separate cytoplasmic outlines, whereas a hypersegmented neutrophil has all lobes within one cytoplasm.

65590.recognize_zh: 冠狀面 CT 顯示巨大脾腫；血液抹片中的淋巴細胞為中到大型、核圓、染色質中度濃縮並有單一明顯中央核仁、細胞質中等量，這就是 prolymphocyte，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的 prolymphocytic 進展。
features: Coronal CT showing massive splenomegaly extending into the lower abdomen, with an enlarged liver (panel A)
Blood film dominated by intermediate to large lymphoid cells (panel B)
Round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm with slightly irregular borders
Pink cytoplasmic inclusions not convincingly resolved at this magnification
65590.describe_en: Coronal CT image shows massive splenomegaly. The peripheral blood smear shows numerous intermediate to large lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, a single prominent central nucleolus, and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm with slightly irregular borders. Smudge cells and small mature lymphocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with a prolymphocytic lymphoid population; in a patient with known splenic marginal zone lymphoma and a clonal B-cell phenotype, they support prolymphocytic progression of splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: De novo B-PLL has identical cytology, and separation depends on the documented prior SMZL with the same clone and the absence of an intervening diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma with prolymphocytic morphology
ddx.vs: MCL is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with IGH::CCND1, which must be excluded by FISH or IHC.
CLL retains a majority of small lymphocytes with block chromatin, smudge cells, and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant/splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells have more abundant cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and are CD11c+/CD103+ variable.

65462.recognize_zh: 中央這顆巨大的紅血球前驅細胞有四個大小相近的圓形核，核內可見淡色的包涵體樣區域（箭頭頭所指），細胞質呈灰藍色，邊緣有一個細胞質泡狀突起（長箭頭）。多核的巨大原紅血球加上核內包涵體與細胞質突起，是 parvovirus B19 感染的少見變化。
features: Giant erythroid precursor with four round nuclei of similar size arranged in a cluster
Nuclei with open chromatin and pale, glassy intranuclear inclusion-like areas (short arrowhead)
Moderate grey-blue basophilic cytoplasm with a peripheral cytoplasmic bleb (long arrow)
Paler central perinuclear zone containing fine granular material
Background red cells normochromic with occasional platelets; no other erythroid precursors in the field
65462.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, oil immersion, shows a giant erythroid precursor containing four round nuclei with open chromatin and pale intranuclear inclusion-like areas. The cytoplasm is moderately basophilic with a paler central zone and a peripheral cytoplasmic bleb. The surrounding field contains red cells and platelets without additional maturing erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with a multinucleated giant proerythroblast associated with parvovirus B19 infection; correlation with parvovirus PCR or serology and reticulocyte count is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS-related multinucleation affects later-stage erythroblasts with nuclear budding and megaloblastoid change, without viral intranuclear inclusions.
CDA III produces giant multinucleated late erythroblasts (up to 12 nuclei) with ongoing erythroid hyperplasia, not a proerythroblast with inclusions in erythroid aplasia.
Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm, and osteoclasts have many separate nuclei with abundant pink granular cytoplasm.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of atypical pronormoblasts, some multinucleated, rather than an isolated giant precursor with viral inclusions.

65398.recognize_zh: 畫面中央單一漿細胞核偏位，細胞質豐富且邊緣染成粉紅至洋紅色（flame cell 火焰狀細胞），背景紅血球呈錢串狀排列。
features: Single plasma cell with a small, eccentric round nucleus and coarse chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with a pink-magenta peripheral rim (flame cell appearance)
Paler perinuclear/central cytoplasm
Background red cells in rouleaux stacks
Only one cell shown; overall plasma cell burden cannot be assessed
65398.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant cytoplasm whose periphery stains reddish-magenta, characteristic of a flame cell. The surrounding red cells form rouleaux. Flame cells reflect immunoglobulin-rich cytoplasm and are classically associated with IgA myeloma, but are not specific. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the provided context; plasma cell percentage cannot be judged from this single field.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells with flame morphology
ddx.vs: Flame cells can occur in reactive states; polytypic light-chain staining and absence of a monoclonal protein exclude a neoplasm.
Mott cells contain multiple round pale-blue Russell bodies filling the cytoplasm rather than a diffuse pink-magenta peripheral rim.
Osteoblasts are larger with a pale zone separate from the nucleus and lack magenta cytoplasmic edges.

65014.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎所有紅血球都是長橢圓形到棒狀的橢圓形紅血球（elliptocytes），大小與色素大致一致、兩端鈍圓，沒有明顯碎片或微球形細胞，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球增多症。
features: Majority (>50%) of red cells are elliptocytes and ovalocytes, some elongated rod-like forms
Elliptocytes are normochromic with blunt rounded ends and relatively uniform size
No significant fragmented cells, microspherocytes or budding forms in this field
No teardrop cells, target cells or red cell inclusions
No leukocytes or platelets clumps included in this field
65014.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a red cell population composed predominantly of elliptocytes and ovalocytes, including elongated rod-like forms, accounting for well over half of the red cells. The cells are normochromic with blunt ends and relatively uniform size. Red cell fragments, microspherocytes, teardrop cells, and inclusions are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis; correlation with family history, hemolytic markers, and membrane protein or genetic studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: HPP shows marked microcytosis with fragments, budding cells and microspherocytes in addition to elliptocytes, which are absent here.
Pencil cells in iron deficiency are hypochromic and microcytic and accompany anisocytosis, rather than a uniform normochromic elliptocyte population.
Acquired elliptocytes occur with teardrop cells, leukoerythroblastosis or dysplastic changes rather than as a uniform predominant population.
SAO cells are rounder, macro-ovalocytic stomatocytes with one or two transverse bars or slits.

65206.recognize_zh: 這是非形態學圖：FISH 間期核中 RUNX1（紅）訊號多達 4–5 個而 ETV6（綠）只有 2 個，表示第 21 號染色體內擴增（iAMP21）；核型可見衍生自 rob(14;21) 的異常染色體，t-SNE 表現譜落在 iAMP21 群，WGS 顯示 chr14 與 chr21 拷貝數震盪。
features: Interphase FISH (ETV6 green / RUNX1 red): 4-5 RUNX1 signals with 2 ETV6 signals per nucleus, indicating RUNX1 amplification without ETV6::RUNX1 fusion
G-banded karyotype with abnormal chromosome 21 material, a marker chromosome, and a derivative 14;21 Robertsonian chromosome (inset)
t-SNE of transcriptome profiles places the patient sample within the iAMP21 B-ALL cluster
Whole-genome copy-number plot shows oscillating copy states across chr14 and distal chr21 with interconnecting structural rearrangement arcs (chromothripsis-like pattern)
65206.describe_en: This composite figure is non-morphologic. Interphase FISH with ETV6/RUNX1 probes shows 4 to 5 RUNX1 signals with only two ETV6 signals, consistent with intrachromosomal amplification of chromosome 21 rather than ETV6::RUNX1 fusion. The karyotype shows abnormal chromosome 21 and a derivative chromosome arising from a constitutional rob(14;21), and transcriptome t-SNE clustering places the sample with iAMP21 cases. Whole-genome sequencing demonstrates oscillating copy numbers and structural rearrangements between chromosomes 14 and 21. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with iAMP21 arising on a constitutional Robertsonian translocation chromosome.

ddx.vs: ETV6::RUNX1 shows fused red-green signals with loss of a separate ETV6 signal, not isolated amplification of RUNX1 signals.

ddx.dx: High hyperdiploid B-ALL or constitutional trisomy 21
ddx.vs: Whole chromosome 21 gains give only 3-4 RUNX1 signals that track with whole chromosome copies, whereas iAMP21 requires ≥5 RUNX1 signals (or ≥3 extra copies on one abnormal chromosome 21).

65078.recognize_zh: 拼圖中的中型淋巴母細胞核圓、染色質細緻呈顆粒狀，細胞質深藍色並含多個邊界清楚的透明脂質空泡，是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤的典型細胞學；但這是抹片而非組織切片，看不到標題描述的「星空」（starry sky）組織型態。
features: Composite of smear fields showing medium-sized, monomorphic lymphoid cells (about 2x a red cell)
Round to slightly squared nuclei with finely granular, stippled chromatin and small inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple sharply punched-out clear cytoplasmic (lipid) vacuoles, often also overlying the nucleus
Background of red cells without tingible body macrophages; histologic starry sky pattern not assessable
65078.describe_en: Smear preparation (composite of several fields) shows medium-sized, monomorphic lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous sharply defined clear vacuoles. The cells occur singly and in small groups against a background of red cells; the specimen appears to be blood or a dilute aspirate. The starry sky pattern mentioned in the case description is a tissue-section finding and cannot be seen on this smear. The cytologic features are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia, which requires confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2-, surface light chain restricted, Ki-67 near 100% on tissue) and demonstration of MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have finer, more homogeneous chromatin, scant pale cytoplasm and few vacuoles, and are TdT/CD34 positive with no surface light chain, whereas Burkitt cells are TdT negative and surface immunoglobulin positive.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma can look Burkitt-like with vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, but typically shows more nuclear pleomorphism, BCL2 protein expression and BCL2 rearrangement by FISH.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with vacuolated blasts (e.g., monoblastic)
ddx.vs: Vacuolated myeloid blasts have folded nuclei, prominent nucleoli, grey-blue cytoplasm and may show granules or Auer rods, and are MPO or nonspecific esterase positive rather than CD19/CD10 positive.

64886.recognize_zh: 左下那顆分葉嗜中性球的胞質中有四顆金黃色、邊緣清楚的菱形／長方形折光結晶，周圍胞質有空泡化；右側另一顆核呈摺疊狀的白血球，背景紅血球皺縮，符合 EDTA 抽血後形成的膽紅素結晶。
features: Segmented neutrophil with multiple golden-yellow, refractile rhomboid to rectangular cytoplasmic crystals
Vacuolated neutrophil cytoplasm consistent with toxic change
Adjacent leukocyte with a large folded nucleus and pale vacuolated cytoplasm (band or monocyte)
Background crenated red cells (echinocytic artifact)
Scattered platelets
64886.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing several sharply outlined, golden-yellow refractile rhomboid and rectangular crystals within vacuolated cytoplasm. An adjacent leukocyte with a large folded nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm is present, and the background red cells show diffuse crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with bilirubin crystals in neutrophils, an in vitro EDTA-related phenomenon seen with marked hyperbilirubinemia, often in septic neonates, accompanied by toxic neutrophil changes.

ddx.vs: Cryoglobulin inclusions are pale blue to colorless and dissolve on warming, unlike golden yellow bilirubin crystals.
Hemosiderin is irregular granular brown pigment that stains with Prussian blue, not geometric refractile crystals.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background in variable focal planes, whereas bilirubin crystals are confined to neutrophil cytoplasm.

64822.recognize_zh: CD163 染色使大量樹枝狀、胞質豐富的組織球呈棕色陽性並形成網狀背景，而夾在其間、核較大的淡藍色非典型細胞為陰性，說明淋巴組織球型 ALCL 中腫瘤細胞被大量組織球遮蔽。
features: Numerous CD163-positive histiocytes with abundant, irregular, branching cytoplasm
Positive cells form a dense interlacing network throughout the field
Interspersed CD163-negative cells with larger, pale blue counterstained nuclei (neoplastic cells)
Smaller negative lymphocytes also present between histiocytes
64822.describe_en: CD163 immunohistochemistry highlights a dense, interlacing population of histiocytes with abundant branching cytoplasm distributed throughout the lesion. Scattered between them are CD163-negative atypical cells with enlarged nuclei, visible only on the hematoxylin counterstain, along with smaller negative lymphocytes. The histiocyte-rich background obscures the neoplastic cells, which are better demonstrated with CD30 and ALK. Findings are consistent with the lymphohistiocytic pattern of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In histiocytic sarcoma the large atypical cells themselves are CD163 and CD68 positive, whereas here the atypical nuclei are negative.
It also has a histiocyte-rich background, but the scattered large cells are CD20 and PAX5 positive and CD30 and ALK negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive histiocytic lymphadenitis (e.g., Kikuchi or infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive processes lack a population of CD30- and ALK-positive atypical cells.
Epithelioid histiocyte clusters are admixed with small to medium atypical T cells that are ALK negative with variable CD30.

64694.recognize_zh: 低倍下小腸黏膜（左側可見隱窩）下方被一大片密集、單調的淋巴樣細胞浸潤取代並擴張腸壁，缺乏濾泡結構，提示腸道淋巴瘤；表皮嗜性（epitheliotropism）需在高倍確認。
features: Dense, diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells effacing the bowel wall
Residual intestinal mucosa with crypts at the left edge, partly infiltrated at its base
No follicular or nodular architecture; no geographic necrosis evident
Scattered small blood vessels traversing the infiltrate
Crush/fold artifact in the mucosa; epitheliotropism not resolvable at this magnification
64694.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of small intestine shows residual mucosa with crypts at the periphery and a massive, diffuse, transmural-appearing infiltrate of monotonous lymphoid cells that expands and effaces the underlying wall. The infiltrate is sheet-like, without follicles, prominent necrosis, or a conspicuous inflammatory background. Intraepithelial involvement cannot be evaluated at this power and requires higher magnification. In the context of CD3+, CD56+, TIA1+ tumor cells with epitheliotropism, findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: EATL shows pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with abundant necrosis and an inflammatory background, is usually CD56-negative, and arises in celiac disease, unlike the monotonous CD56+ infiltrate of MEITL.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the intestine
ddx.vs: DLBCL has larger cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and is CD20+/CD3-, whereas MEITL cells are small-to-medium and CD3+/CD8+/CD56+.
ENKTL shows angiocentricity with extensive necrosis and is EBER-positive, while MEITL is EBV-negative and characteristically epitheliotropic.
MCL is composed of small cleaved B cells that are CD20+, CD5+ and cyclin D1+, rather than CD3+ cytotoxic T cells.

64502.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色的 CD19+ B 細胞群（約占全部事件 67%）側向散射偏高，並同時表現 CD103、CD11c（強）、CD25 與 CD123，CD13 陰性，是典型毛細胞白血病的免疫表型組合。
features: Gating: singlets and viable cells, then CD45 vs SSC shows a CD45-bright population with higher side scatter than normal lymphocytes
Abnormal CD19-bright B-cell population (red) comprising ~82% of viable events (~67% of total events)
Red population is CD103 positive and CD123 positive (moderate)
Red population is CD11c bright and CD25 positive
CD13 negative; CD43 negative to dim with CD49d expression, distinct from CD43+ normal T/NK lymphocytes (blue)
CD20 and light-chain restriction are not displayed in this figure
64502.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis (gated on singlet viable events) reveals an abnormal CD19-bright B-cell population (red) comprising approximately 82% of viable events, with increased side scatter relative to normal lymphocytes on CD45 versus SSC. The population co-expresses CD103, bright CD11c, CD25 and CD123, is negative for CD13, and is negative to dim for CD43 with CD49d expression, in contrast to the residual CD43-positive normal lymphocytes (blue). CD20 and surface light-chain plots are not shown, so clonality cannot be confirmed from this figure alone. The immunophenotype is characteristic of hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v is typically CD103+ and CD11c+ but CD25-negative and CD123-negative, unlike the CD25+ CD123+ population here.
SMZL may express CD11c and occasionally CD25 or CD103 but usually not all four HCL markers together, and lacks bright CD123 and increased side scatter.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL is often CD11c+ and may be CD103+ but is usually CD25-, CD123- and annexin A1-negative.
CLL is CD5+, CD23+, CD43+ with dim CD20 and dim light chain, and lacks CD103, CD25 bright and CD123 coexpression.

64566.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片裡嗜酸性系細胞明顯增加，從帶粗大橘紅顆粒的圓核嗜酸性骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞到成熟嗜酸性球都有，部分細胞還混有深紫色顆粒，代表嗜酸性球增生並伴有成熟異常。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and abundant orange-red granules
Several precursors with admixed dark purple (basophilic-appearing) granules
Occasional mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei
Admixed neutrophilic precursors, erythroid precursors, and a few cells with blue agranular cytoplasm
Scattered free granules in the background from ruptured cells
64566.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased eosinophils at all stages of maturation, including numerous eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse orange-red granules and occasional mature bilobed eosinophils. Some eosinophil precursors contain admixed dark purple granules. Neutrophilic and erythroid precursors are also present; blasts are not conspicuously increased in this field. Findings are consistent with marked marrow eosinophilia, which in this context supports a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement pending cytogenetic/molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: inv(16) shows increased myelomonocytic blasts (≥20% or with the defining genetics) and abnormal eosinophils with large purple granules, separated by karyotype/FISH.
Reactive eosinophilia shows well-granulated eosinophils with orderly maturation and no associated gene rearrangement.
Mastocytosis shows spindle-shaped metachromatic mast cells with CD25/CD117 aberrancy and KIT D816V mutation rather than only eosinophil lineage expansion.

64438.recognize_zh: 骨髓中有大型異型細胞，細胞質豐富且有空泡，核卵圓或凹陷並有明顯核仁，細胞質內還吞入造血細胞，外觀很像噬血組織球。但角蛋白（CAM5.2）強陽性、非特異性酯酶陰性，證實是轉移性癌而非 HLH 的組織球。
features: Panel A (aspirate): large atypical cells with abundant blue vacuolated cytoplasm and ovoid to indented nuclei with prominent nucleoli
Engulfed hematopoietic cells (neutrophils, erythroid cells) within the cytoplasm of the large cells, mimicking hemophagocytosis
Panel B (H&E): large cells with vacuolated cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli containing phagocytosed cells, some forming small clusters
Panel C: strong cytoplasmic keratin (CAM5.2) staining of the large cells, including those with engulfed cells
Panel D: nonspecific esterase negative in the large cell, arguing against a monocytic/histiocytic lineage
Background myeloid-rich hematopoiesis
64438.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy show large atypical cells with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm, ovoid to indented nuclei and prominent nucleoli, many of which contain phagocytosed hematopoietic cells, closely mimicking hemophagocytic histiocytes. By immunohistochemistry the cells are strongly positive for keratins (AE1/AE3, CAM5.2) and negative for CD68, CD163 and lysozyme, and nonspecific esterase cytochemistry is negative. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma showing cannibalism/phagocytosis of hematopoietic cells, mimicking hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: HLH macrophages have bland small nuclei without prominent nucleoli and are CD68/CD163-positive and keratin-negative.
Monocytic and histiocytic neoplasms are nonspecific esterase, lysozyme, CD163 and CD68-positive, while these cells are keratin-positive and NSE-negative.
Melanoma cells can show prominent nucleoli and phagocytosis but are SOX10/S100/Melan-A-positive and keratin-negative.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma with hemophagocytosis
ddx.vs: ALCL cells are CD30+ with T-cell or ALK markers and do not express cytokeratins.

64438.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CAM5.2; nonspecific esterase

64182.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，整個視野布滿大量深藍紫色的小圓形淋巴球，並散布許多淡紫色、形狀不規則的破碎細胞（smudge cells），即使在低倍下就能看出白血球明顯增加且以小淋巴球為主，提示 CLL。
features: Marked leukocytosis evident at low power, composed predominantly of small round dark lymphocytes
Numerous smudge cells appearing as pale lilac, irregular, flattened nuclear remnants
Monotonous population without obvious large blasts at this magnification
Red cells evenly spread in a monolayer
Low magnification precludes assessment of chromatin detail
64182.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in leukocytes, which are predominantly small, round, dark lymphocytes distributed evenly among the red cells. Numerous smudge cells are present. Detailed cytology cannot be assessed at this magnification, but no large blast population is apparent. Findings are suggestive of chronic lymphocytic leukemia; high-power review and flow cytometry are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: MCL may mimic CLL at low power but usually has fewer smudge cells and more irregular nuclei, with cyclin D1 positivity.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size with abundant cytoplasm and are polyclonal, and smudge cells are few.
ALL blasts are larger with fine chromatin and nucleoli on high power and are TdT-positive.

64118.recognize_zh: 中央一顆活化巨噬細胞，胞質淡藍灰、邊緣不規則且有空泡，胞質內可見一顆完整的帶狀/分葉嗜中性球、一顆圓核單核細胞與紅血球物質；巨噬細胞吞噬完整血球，是 HLH 的噬血現象。
features: Large activated macrophage with abundant pale gray-blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular borders
Engulfed intact band/segmented neutrophil with a horseshoe-shaped nucleus inside a vacuole
Additional ingested mononuclear cell with a round nucleus and dense dark cell remnants
Background: eosinophils, segmented neutrophils, larger immature myeloid/erythroid precursors, and red cells
Degenerating smudged cells at the lower right
64118.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large activated macrophage with abundant, pale, vacuolated cytoplasm containing an intact band neutrophil within a phagocytic vacuole, an additional mononuclear cell, and dense cellular remnants. The background includes eosinophils, segmented neutrophils, and immature hematopoietic precursors without an obvious blast population in this field. The findings represent hemophagocytosis by an activated macrophage. This is supportive of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, but the diagnosis requires fulfilment of clinical and laboratory criteria (HLH-2004 or HScore) and a search for an underlying trigger.

ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytes appear after transfusion, infection, or chemotherapy without the systemic HLH syndrome, so morphology alone cannot diagnose HLH.
Contains fragmented apoptotic debris instead of whole identifiable cells such as the intact band neutrophil here.
The host cell in emperipolesis is a megakaryocyte with a large lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than a vacuolated macrophage.
Overlapping cells sit on top of the macrophage without a surrounding clear vacuole.

64054.recognize_zh: 印片（imprint smear）中細胞密度高，多為中至大型、核質比極高的單一型態細胞，核圓或輕度不規則、染色質細緻，符合母細胞樣淋巴細胞；但此影像染色偏紫、對焦有限，標題所述的明顯核仁在圖中不易辨認。
features: Cellular imprint with a monotonous population of intermediate-to-large mononuclear cells
Very high N:C ratio with scant, barely discernible cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular or indented nuclear contours
Finely dispersed, intensely stained chromatin; nucleoli are not clearly resolved at this image quality
Scattered small mature lymphocyte for size comparison; background of overlapping red cells and debris
Occasional crush/smudged cells
64054.describe_en: Touch imprint smear is cellular and shows a monotonous population of intermediate-to-large atypical lymphoid cells, roughly two to three times the size of an adjacent small lymphocyte. The cells have very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclear contours and finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli, although described, are not clearly resolvable in this image because of overstaining and limited focus. No maturing myeloid elements are evident in the field. Findings are consistent with infiltration by blastoid lymphoid cells of a high-grade lymphoma, with correlation to histology and immunophenotyping required.

ddx.vs: True blasts are TdT/CD34 positive with delicate chromatin and, if myeloid, may show granules or Auer rods, so flow cytometry is required to separate them from blastoid mature lymphoma.
Blastoid MCL cells look identical on smears but are CD5+/cyclin D1+/SOX11+ and TdT-negative.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles, which are not seen here.
DLBCL cells are usually larger with more cytoplasm and more obvious nucleoli; immunophenotype and histology separate it from transformed follicular lymphoma.

63990.recognize_zh: 油鏡下骨髓抹片充滿大型芽細胞（細緻染色質、可見核仁、中等量藍灰色胞質），上方箭頭處可見細長粉紅色 Auer 桿狀體；下方箭頭指向一個胞質豐富、深藍且帶纖維狀紋理的大細胞，為類 Gaucher 細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cell）。
features: Sheets of large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin, and one or more nucleoli
Round to indented nuclei with moderate blue-gray agranular cytoplasm, some blasts with pale perinuclear/cytoplasmic clear zones
Thin pink needle-like Auer rod (upper arrow)
Large macrophage with abundant dense blue, finely fibrillar cytoplasm and small eccentric nucleus, consistent with a pseudo-Gaucher cell (lower arrow)
Occasional small mature lymphocytes/erythroid precursors and red cells in the background
63990.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marked increase in large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and moderate amounts of blue-gray cytoplasm. A slender Auer rod is identified (upper arrow), establishing myeloid lineage. A large histiocyte with abundant deeply basophilic, finely fibrillar cytoplasm (lower arrow) is also present, resembling a Gaucher cell. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with pseudo-Gaucher cells, which reflect increased cell turnover overwhelming macrophage glucocerebroside catabolism rather than inherited Gaucher disease.

ddx.vs: True Gaucher disease occurs without a leukemic blast population and shows low glucocerebrosidase activity, whereas pseudo-Gaucher cells here arise in a marrow replaced by blasts.

ddx.dx: Sea-blue histiocytes or other storage histiocytes
ddx.vs: Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules, whereas Gaucher-like cells have crumpled tissue-paper striated cytoplasm.
Lymphoblasts lack Auer rods and are MPO negative, whereas the Auer rod here defines myeloid lineage.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with granular cytoplasm and tumor cells form cohesive clusters, unlike the single fibrillar-cytoplasm macrophage shown.

63862.recognize_zh: 這是試管的肉眼照片而非顯微鏡圖：離心後試管底部的液體呈不透明、乳白偏淡粉紅色，透光性差，表示液體中有大量散射光線的脂蛋白顆粒（乳糜微粒/VLDL），對應三酸甘油脂高達 1500 mg/dL 的乳糜狀檢體。
features: Gross photograph of a glass tube held horizontally over gauze
Fluid in the tube is opaque, creamy white with a pale pink-orange tinge rather than clear straw-colored
Poor light transmission through the fluid, indicating turbidity
No distinct cream layer or cell pellet can be resolved at this angle and resolution
63862.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic gross photograph of a centrifuged specimen in a glass tube. The supernatant is opaque and creamy (lactescent) with a faint pink tinge instead of being clear, although a separate floating cream layer cannot be resolved at this angle. Marked plasma turbidity of this kind indicates high concentrations of light-scattering triglyceride-rich lipoproteins, correlating with the reported triglyceride level of 1500 mg/dL. Findings are consistent with lipemia due to severe hypertriglyceridemia, which can interfere with automated hematology and chemistry assays and clog extracorporeal circuits.

ddx.dx: Chylous effusion or chylomicronemia (type I hyperlipoproteinemia)
ddx.vs: Chylomicrons float as a creamy top layer after overnight refrigeration with a clear infranatant, whereas VLDL excess (type IV) leaves diffusely turbid plasma.
Hemolysis gives a transparent red-pink supernatant from free hemoglobin rather than an opaque milky one.

ddx.dx: Propofol or intravenous lipid emulsion infusion
ddx.vs: Exogenous lipid produces similar lactescence, so drug and nutrition history and repeat sampling after stopping infusion are needed.
Cryoglobulins precipitate as a gel or white sediment in the cold that redissolves at 37 C, with normal triglyceride levels.

63798.recognize_zh: 箭頭指出兩個深染、兩端平直的長方形棒狀結晶（hemoglobin C crystal），周圍紅血球有標靶細胞、摺疊細胞與小球形細胞，符合同型合子血紅素 C 病（HbCC）。
features: Dense, homogeneous, rectangular rod-shaped crystals with blunt parallel ends (arrows)
Crystals appear free or within scant residual red cell membrane, darker than surrounding red cells
Many target cells and folded/fold-like red cells
Occasional microspherocytes and crenated cells
Platelets present; no nucleated red cells in this field
63798.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two dense, homogeneous, rectangular rod-shaped crystals with blunt parallel ends (arrows), lying within minimal residual red cell membrane. The background red cells include numerous target cells, folded cells, occasional microspherocytes and crenated cells. Platelets are present. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C crystals in homozygous hemoglobin C disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: Crystals are irregular, with finger-like or glove-shaped projections (SC crystals) and may coexist with occasional sickle cells.
Sickle cells are elongated, crescent-shaped with pointed ends and thinner profile, rather than dense rectangular bars with blunt ends.
Artifactual precipitates lie outside red cells, are refractile or irregular, and are not accompanied by target and folded cells.
Crystals are rare in trait; C/beta-thalassemia shows more microcytosis with target cells and requires electrophoresis to separate.

63734.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中有一條遠大於血球、蜷曲成環狀的細長蟲體，體內充滿深紫色、成柱狀排列的細胞核，這就是血中微絲蟲（microfilaria）；此張解析度下鞘膜與尾端無核的特徵看不太清楚，需結合流行區與夜間採血確認為班氏絲蟲。
features: Large elongated, coiled/looped worm many times the length of a red cell
Body packed with deeply basophilic nuclei in a column along its length
Rounded cephalic end; tail end and sheath not clearly resolved at this contrast
Dense background of red cells with low-contrast, greyish staining (thick area of smear)
No accompanying leukocyte detail assessable
63734.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large, coiled microfilaria lying among densely packed red cells. The organism is elongated and slender, many times the length of an erythrocyte, with a column of deeply basophilic somatic nuclei extending along the body. A sheath and the pattern of nuclei at the tail tip, which are needed for species identification, are not clearly resolved in this image. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia, compatible with Wuchereria bancrofti in the appropriate epidemiologic setting; species confirmation relies on sheath, tail nuclei and periodicity or antigen/PCR testing.

ddx.vs: Brugia microfilariae are sheathed with a sheath staining pink on Giemsa and two separate terminal nuclei at the tail tip, whereas W. bancrofti has a tail free of nuclei.
Loa loa is sheathed with nuclei extending continuously to the tip of the tail and shows diurnal periodicity.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller and unsheathed with nuclei to a blunt tail tip.

ddx.dx: Fibrin strand or cotton fiber artifact
ddx.vs: Fibers and fibrin lack a column of discrete nuclei and a defined head and tail.

63606.recognize_zh: 中央一顆白血球的細胞質內充滿大小不一、比一般顆粒明顯粗大的深紫色圓形或不規則包涵體，部分遮蓋細胞核，病人有 AML 化療史，符合假性 Chediak-Higashi 顆粒（pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules）；背景紅血球上的小黑點為染料沉澱。
features: Single leukocyte slightly larger than surrounding red cells
Cytoplasm containing numerous large, round to irregular, dark purple inclusions much coarser than normal azurophilic granules
Inclusions partly overlie a dark, irregular nucleus, obscuring nuclear detail
Background red cells with abundant fine dark dots consistent with stain precipitate artifact
Image resolution and overlying granules limit assessment of chromatin and nucleoli
63606.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocyte whose cytoplasm is filled with multiple large, round to irregular, dark purple inclusions that are considerably larger than normal azurophilic granules and partly obscure the nucleus. The background red cells are overlaid by fine dark stain precipitate, which should not be mistaken for inclusions. Nuclear detail is limited by the granules and image resolution. In a patient treated for acute myeloid leukemia, the findings are consistent with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules in a myeloid cell.

ddx.vs: Inherited Chediak-Higashi shows giant granules in all granulocytes, lymphocytes and monocytes with albinism and infections, rather than in a subset of neoplastic myeloid cells.
Basophil granules are uniformly dense purple-black and water-soluble, filling the cell in a smaller, more regular pattern than giant fused inclusions.
Toxic granules are fine, evenly distributed dark granules in mature neutrophils, not giant irregular inclusions.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense, uniform and present in all leukocytes of patients with mucopolysaccharidoses.

63542.recognize_zh: A 圖在混合發炎細胞背景中有一顆雙核、核仁明顯的大細胞（RS cell，箭頭）；免疫染色中大細胞 CD15、CD30 陽性（B、F），背景大量 CD3 陽性小 T 細胞（E），支持骨髓侵犯的典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤（classical Hodgkin lymphoma）。
features: Panel A (H&E): large binucleate cell with two round nuclei, each with a prominent nucleolus, in a loose background of small lymphocytes and stromal cells (Reed-Sternberg cell)
Panel B: large cell with membranous/Golgi-type CD15 positivity (arrow) among negative small cells
Panel F: weak membranous and paranuclear CD30 staining in a large cell (arrow)
Panel D: CD20 membranous staining in a sheet of cells around the arrowed large cell; tumor-cell positivity is hard to separate from background B cells at this resolution
Panel E: abundant CD3-positive small T cells forming the background infiltrate
Panel C: low Ki-67 index with scattered positive nuclei
63542.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow biopsy H&E and immunohistochemistry. The H&E section (A) shows a large binucleate cell with round nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell, set within a background of small lymphocytes and stroma. Immunostains show scattered large cells positive for CD15 (B) and CD30 (F), with a background rich in CD3-positive small T cells (E) and scattered Ki-67-positive nuclei (C); CD20 (D) shows membranous staining in a cellular area around the arrowed large cell, although distinguishing tumor-cell staining from reactive B cells is limited in this image. Given CD30 and CD15 positivity in Reed-Sternberg cells within a T-cell-rich inflammatory background (with PAX5 positivity and CD3/EMA negativity reported), findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by classical Hodgkin lymphoma (stage IV).

ddx.vs: THRLBCL large cells are strongly and uniformly CD20+, CD45+, CD15- and CD30-, whereas classical RS cells are CD30+ CD15+ with weak or absent CD20 and dim PAX5.
ALCL hallmark cells are CD30+ in a strong uniform pattern, often EMA+ and ALK+ with T-cell markers or cytotoxic granules, and PAX5 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive immunoblasts in the marrow (e.g., viral infection)
ddx.vs: Immunoblasts are CD30 variable but CD15 negative and lack binucleate RS morphology and a clonal context.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei without large inclusion-like nucleoli and are CD61/CD42b positive and CD30/CD15 negative.

63542.stain: H&E; IHC: CD15, CD30, CD20, CD3, Ki-67

63478.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片右側一顆大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，深藍色細胞質緊貼核周並帶細顆粒感；中間及周圍有多顆比紅血球小不了多少、淡藍無顆粒或帶粉紅顆粒的巨大異常血小板，配合 CML 病史符合巨核母細胞急變。
features: Large blast (right) with round nucleus, finely granular chromatin, and a thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Small cytoplasmic bleb/attached platelet-like fragment at the blast margin
Multiple giant, pale blue, hypogranular platelets approaching red cell size (center and lower left)
Occasional platelet with clustered pink-purple granules and a small platelet clump (left)
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas and scattered echinocytes
63478.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large blast with a round nucleus, finely granular chromatin, and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a small marginal cytoplasmic bleb. Several giant, pale blue, hypogranular platelets approaching the size of red cells are present, along with a few granular platelets. Red cells show scattered echinocytes and stacking in thicker areas. Blast lineage cannot be established morphologically, but in a patient with known CML and flow cytometry demonstrating CD41/CD61-positive blasts, findings are consistent with megakaryoblastic blast crisis with dysplastic giant platelets.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, whereas megakaryoblasts are MPO negative and express CD41/CD61.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebs and are accompanied by normal-sized platelets, and they express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
Congenital giant platelets occur without circulating blasts or leukocytosis.
Myelofibrosis shows teardrop cells, nucleated red cells, and giant platelets with only low blast counts and no BCR::ABL1 fusion.

63350.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大量小型成熟淋巴球，其中多顆細胞質內有圓形透明的球狀包涵體，並可見多個塗抹細胞（smudge cell）；箭頭所指的嗜中性球則沒有包涵體，顯示包涵體只出現在 CLL 淋巴球。
features: Absolute increase in small mature lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and condensed clumped chromatin
Several lymphocytes contain round, clear-to-pale globular cytoplasmic inclusions, often indenting the nucleus
Numerous smudge (basket) cells
Neutrophil (green arrow) with segmented nucleus and no inclusion
Red cells largely normocytic with a few scattered platelets
63350.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocytosis composed of small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. A subset of lymphocytes contains round, pale globular cytoplasmic inclusions that indent the nucleus. A neighboring neutrophil lacks such inclusions. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with unusual lymphocyte cytoplasmic inclusions; flow cytometric immunophenotyping is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Lysosomal storage disease with vacuolated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Storage disorders show multiple small punched-out vacuoles in non-clonal lymphocytes in young patients, without smudge cells or a monoclonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
LPL cells show plasmacytoid features and may contain Dutcher/Russell bodies that are PAS-positive, with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
MCL cells have more irregular nuclear contours and are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, which flow and IHC resolve.
Artifactual vacuoles appear in thick areas and affect all cell types, whereas these inclusions spare the neutrophil.

63286.recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色中大量芽細胞呈棕色陽性，箭頭所指是一顆單核、胞質豐富且 CD34 強陽性的較大細胞，型態像異常的小型巨核細胞，屬於 AML-MRC 中常見的芽細胞增加與巨核細胞異生表現。
features: Arrowed larger cell with a single round nucleus and abundant cytoplasm showing strong granular CD34 staining, consistent with an aberrant CD34-positive small megakaryocyte
Numerous CD34-positive mononuclear cells with membranous and cytoplasmic staining in sheets and clusters
A focus of CD34-negative small cells with round dense nuclei (likely erythroid precursors) in the lower center
Adipocytes and CD34-negative cells with blue counterstained nuclei
63286.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD34 shows numerous CD34-positive blasts with membranous and cytoplasmic staining arranged in sheets and clusters. The arrow highlights a larger cell with a single round nucleus and abundant, strongly CD34-positive cytoplasm, morphologically consistent with an aberrantly CD34-expressing small (dysplastic) megakaryocyte. A cluster of CD34-negative small round cells, likely erythroid precursors, is also present. Findings support a marked increase in blasts with megakaryocytic dysplasia, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes; CD61 immunostaining can confirm megakaryocytic lineage.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cell or small vessel cut in cross-section
ddx.vs: Endothelium stains as thin linear or ring-like profiles around a lumen rather than a single rounded cell with abundant cytoplasm.
MDS-IB also shows CD34+ blast clusters and dysplastic megakaryocytes but with a blast percentage below the AML threshold.
AMKL shows a predominant population of megakaryoblasts that are CD61/CD42b-positive, often with marrow fibrosis, rather than scattered dysplastic megakaryocytes among myeloblasts.

63222.recognize_zh: 上圖黑箭頭為漿細胞：偏心核、深藍色胞質；下圖灰箭頭為 Mott 細胞，胞質塞滿大小一致的淡藍色圓形 Russell 小體，像一串葡萄，核被擠到一側。
features: Plasma cell (top, black arrow): small eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Mott cell (bottom, gray arrow): cytoplasm distended by numerous uniform, round, pale blue globules (Russell bodies) in a grape-cluster arrangement
Mott cell nucleus small, dense and compressed to the periphery
Top field also contains two larger cells with fine azurophilic cytoplasmic granules; bottom field contains mononuclear leukocytes
Red cells stacked in rouleaux-like chains in the bottom field
63222.describe_en: Composite of two smear fields. The upper field shows a plasma cell (black arrow) with an eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, adjacent to two larger cells with fine azurophilic granules. The lower field shows a Mott cell (gray arrow) whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous uniform, round, pale blue Russell bodies, producing a grape-cluster appearance and compressing the nucleus to the periphery; red cells in this field show rouleaux-like stacking, which may reflect hypergammaglobulinemia or a thicker smear area. Mott cells represent immunoglobulin accumulating in dilated endoplasmic reticulum and occur in reactive plasmacytosis (such as HIV infection) as well as plasma cell neoplasms, so they do not by themselves indicate clonality. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell and a Mott cell.

ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies are single pale intranuclear pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, not multiple cytoplasmic globules.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated cell (e.g., Burkitt cell or activated monocyte)
ddx.vs: Vacuoles are empty clear holes, whereas Russell bodies are filled, homogeneous pale blue to pink globules.
Crystalline inclusions are angular rods or needles rather than uniform round globules.

63030.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞密度偏高，間質內可見多個大型巨核細胞彼此靠近成簇（megakaryocyte clustering），部分核分葉明顯；在 POEMS 症候群中，這種類似骨髓增生性腫瘤（MPN-like）的巨核細胞變化是提示線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with preserved but reduced adipocytes between bony trabeculae
Increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters in the interstitium
Megakaryocytes of variable size, some large with hyperlobated nuclei
Trilineage hematopoiesis with abundant small mature-appearing cells
Bony trabeculae unremarkable at this power; no discrete plasma cell sheets identified
63030.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, low-intermediate power) shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis between unremarkable bony trabeculae. Megakaryocytes are increased and form loose clusters, with variation in size and some large forms with hyperlobated nuclei. No sheets of plasma cells are evident at this magnification. In the appropriate clinical setting, megakaryocytic hyperplasia with clustering is a recognized marrow finding in POEMS syndrome; correlation with plasma cell immunostains (lambda restriction) and exclusion of a myeloproliferative neoplasm (JAK2/CALR/MPL) are recommended.

ddx.vs: MPN shows similar megakaryocyte clustering, but POEMS marrow additionally harbors lambda-restricted plasma cells rimming lymphoid aggregates and lacks JAK2/CALR/MPL driver mutations.

PMF megakaryocytes are more bizarre with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and tight clusters, often with increased reticulin, whereas POEMS megakaryocytes are typically hyperlobated without marked atypia.
Reactive hyperplasia (e.g., ITP, iron deficiency) shows dispersed, morphologically normal megakaryocytes without clustering or an associated clonal plasma cell population.

62966.recognize_zh: 組織切片中巨噬細胞的細胞質內含被吞噬的紅血球（實心箭頭）與有核細胞（空心箭頭），顯示噬血現象；周邊血抹片紅血球內有細小環狀體、成對或四聯體（Maltese cross 樣）的寄生蟲，並見紅血球外成團的蟲體，符合巴貝西蟲症（babesiosis）續發 HLH。
features: Tissue H&E (A): macrophages with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm containing engulfed red cells (solid arrows) and nucleated cells (open arrows) - hemophagocytosis
PB (B-D): small intraerythrocytic ring forms with delicate chromatin dots, often multiple per cell, without pigment
Paired pear-shaped and tetrad (Maltese cross-like) arrangements of parasites within red cells
PB (E): clusters of extracellular parasites adjacent to red cells
Absence of hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; background echinocytes present
62966.describe_en: Composite figure. A tissue section (marrow/spleen) shows macrophages containing phagocytosed red cells and nucleated hematopoietic cells, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Peripheral blood smears show small intraerythrocytic ring forms, frequently multiple within a single red cell, including paired and tetrad arrangements, with clusters of extracellular organisms and no hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; parasitemia should be quantified and PCR used for species confirmation.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum also shows multiple small rings but has banana-shaped gametocytes and hemozoin pigment, and lacks tetrads and extracellular clusters.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells / stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets lie in a different focal plane with a halo and granular texture, not a ring with a chromatin dot inside the cell.

ddx.dx: HLH secondary to EBV or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis is nonspecific; the intraerythrocytic parasites here identify the trigger, whereas EBV/lymphoma require serology, EBER or tissue diagnosis.
These inclusions are solid dots (iron or nuclear remnants) without a ring of cytoplasm or tetrad arrangement.

62902.recognize_zh: 10 倍顯微鏡下 anti-D 試管反應呈大團凝集塊與大量游離紅血球並存的混合場（mixed field）型態；此圖本身只呈現混合場，要推定 D 變異型還需要弱 D（IAT）檢測與輸血史佐證。
features: Large irregular red cell agglutinates distributed unevenly across the field
Abundant free unagglutinated red cells surrounding the agglutinates
Two distinct populations (agglutinated vs free) consistent with a mixed-field reaction
Unstained low-power (10x) view of a tube test with monoclonal IgM anti-D
62902.describe_en: Low-power microscopic view of a conventional tube test with monoclonal IgM anti-D shows large red cell agglutinates set against numerous free, unagglutinated red cells, a mixed-field reaction. The image itself demonstrates only the mixed-field pattern and does not by itself establish a D variant; this requires exclusion of recent transfusion or chimerism and supplementary testing such as weak D testing by indirect antiglobulin technique (positive in this case) and, ideally, RHD genotyping. In this transfusion-dependent patient with aplastic anemia, the finding supports reporting the D type as indeterminate (possible D variant) with transfusion of D-negative red cells.

ddx.dx: Transfused D-positive or D-negative red cells
ddx.vs: An identical mixed field results from a dual population after transfusion; history and repeat testing after the transfused cells clear distinguish it.
Often reacts weakly or negatively with some monoclonal anti-D clones rather than mixed field, and is defined by RHD genotyping and risk of anti-D alloimmunization.
Two genetically distinct red cell populations give mixed field, identified by transplant history and chimerism analysis.

62838.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中 4 個中到大型芽細胞（blasts），核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而嗜鹼性；右側一個芽細胞的胞質內有數顆大小一致、圓形、偏紫紅色的內含物，類似 Chediak-Higashi 巨大顆粒，因此稱為假性 Chediak-Higashi 包涵體（pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions）。
features: Four medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio among red cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods visible
One blast (right) contains several round, uniform, reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusions clustered at one pole
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis; no platelets or mature leukocytes in field
62838.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods. One blast contains multiple round, uniform, reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusions resembling the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome. Lineage cannot be established by morphology; the stated MPO negativity, faint PAS positivity and flow cytometry are required. In the reported context, findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are more common in AML, where the inclusions and blasts are MPO/Sudan black positive, unlike the MPO-negative lymphoblasts here.
The inherited disorder shows giant granules in mature neutrophils, lymphocytes and monocytes of a child with albinism and infections, not in a subset of leukemic blasts.
MPAL requires flow cytometry showing coexpression of myeloid (MPO) and lymphoid lineage markers, which morphology cannot resolve.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out clear lipid vacuoles rather than dense eosinophilic granular inclusions.

62710.recognize_zh: 原始細胞閘門內的 CD13 對 CD33 流式圖：幾乎全部原始細胞 CD33 陽性（約 10³–10⁴·⁷），CD13 則多為陰性到弱陽性，只有部分延伸到 10⁴–10⁵，屬骨髓系相關抗原表現，但 CD13/CD33 本身不足以判定骨髓系別。
features: Gated on blasts; CD13-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Single broad blast population with CD33 expression spanning about 10^3 to 5x10^4
CD13 negative to dim on most blasts with a partial tail of positive events up to about 10^5
Small fraction of blasts with dim CD33 below 10^3
No clearly separate CD13-bright/CD33-bright cluster
62710.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays CD13 versus CD33. The blasts show predominantly positive CD33 expression over a broad intensity range, with CD13 negative to dim and a partial tail of brighter CD13 expression. CD13 and CD33 are myeloid-associated antigens that are frequently expressed aberrantly in B-lymphoblastic leukemia and therefore do not establish myeloid lineage; myeloid assignment in MPAL requires MPO or monocytic differentiation. In context, the findings are in keeping with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: CD13/CD33 co-expression is common in B-ALL (e.g., BCR::ABL1, ETV6::RUNX1) and is distinguished from MPAL by absence of MPO and monocytic differentiation.
CD33/CD13-positive blasts with MPO positivity but no B-lineage commitment markers (strong CD19 with CD79a/cCD22/CD10).
May express CD13/CD33 but shows cytoplasmic CD3 with CD7 and lacks CD19/CD79a.

62582.recognize_zh: BCL2 免疫染色：腫瘤濾泡內幾乎所有細胞呈強而瀰漫的細胞質陽性；正常反應性生發中心的 B 細胞應為 BCL2 陰性，所以生發中心細胞 BCL2 陽性是濾泡性淋巴瘤（t(14;18)）的經典判讀重點。
features: Strong diffuse cytoplasmic and perinuclear BCL2 staining in nearly all neoplastic cells
Positivity involves the entire follicular population rather than only mantle zone or T cells
Only rare scattered negative larger cells
Monotonous medium-sized cells packed closely
62582.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for BCL2 shows strong, diffuse cytoplasmic staining in nearly all of the densely packed neoplastic follicular cells, with only rare negative larger cells. Because reactive germinal-center B cells are BCL2 negative, aberrant BCL2 expression by the follicle-center cells indicates a neoplastic process, typically driven by t(14;18)(q32;q21) IGH::BCL2. BCL2 positivity should be interpreted alongside germinal-center markers to confirm that the positive cells are not residual T cells or mantle cells. Findings support follicular lymphoma (grade 3a in this case).

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are BCL2 negative, with staining limited to mantle zone B cells and intrafollicular T cells.
A subset of high-grade or t(14;18)-negative FL is BCL2 negative or weak, so negativity does not exclude FL.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma or marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are also BCL2 positive but are CD10/BCL6 negative, with MCL cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

62518.recognize_zh: 中倍下左側有一團密集的小型深染細胞核（發炎細胞聚集，可能含嗜中性球），周圍環繞淡染的壞死／纖維素樣物質與呈放射狀排列的梭形上皮樣組織球；這種中心發炎細胞聚集加外圍柵欄狀組織球的結構，符合貓抓病的星狀化膿性肉芽腫。
features: Central aggregate of small, dark, round to lobated nuclei consistent with an inflammatory cell cluster (neutrophils and lymphocytes)
Surrounding pale eosinophilic fibrinoid/necrotic material
Spindled to epithelioid histiocytes radiating around the inflammatory center
Peripheral pale lymphoid parenchyma; resolution limits distinction of neutrophils from lymphocytes
62518.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows a central aggregate of small dark inflammatory cells, likely including neutrophils and lymphocytes, embedded in pale eosinophilic fibrinoid and necrotic material and surrounded by spindled to epithelioid histiocytes arranged in a radiating, palisading fashion. The image resolution limits confident separation of neutrophils from lymphocytes. No atypical cells or organisms are visible on H&E. The pattern is suggestive of a suppurative granuloma (microabscess with a histiocytic rim), consistent with cat scratch disease in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: LGV forms identical stellate abscesses but involves inguinal nodes after sexual exposure and is confirmed by Chlamydia testing.
These also show suppurative granulomas and are separated by exposure history, mesenteric location (Yersinia), culture or serology.
Mycobacterial granulomas have caseous rather than neutrophil-rich centers and acid-fast bacilli.

62454.recognize_zh: 左下角為一顆中型淋巴球，核佔滿細胞且輪廓略有凹陷，染色質呈顆粒狀並有細褶紋，細胞質少呈藍色；右上為一顆核圓、染色質緻密的小淋巴球，兩者可作對比，前者較符合 Sézary 細胞，但腦回狀褶紋細微。
features: Lower left: medium-sized lymphoid cell with high N:C ratio and a slightly indented, irregular nuclear contour
Lower left cell: granular chromatin with fine folds or grooves, no conspicuous nucleolus, scant blue cytoplasm with an irregular edge
Upper right: small lymphocyte with round, dense hyperchromatic nucleus and minimal cytoplasm for comparison
Background normocytic red cells with occasional folded forms and scattered platelets
62454.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized lymphoid cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, an irregular, slightly indented nuclear contour, granular chromatin with fine grooves, and a scant rim of blue cytoplasm, adjacent in the field to a smaller lymphocyte with a round dense nucleus. Nucleoli are not evident. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The larger cell has features suggestive of a Sezary cell, although the cerebriform pattern is subtle at this magnification; findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by mycosis fungoides in the appropriate flow cytometric context.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and smoother nuclei, and are polyclonal without CD7/CD26 loss.
LGLs have moderate pale cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules and a round nucleus, unlike this agranular cell with scant cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Circulating follicular or mantle cell lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Cleaved B-lymphoma cells can mimic nuclear grooves but show a clonal B-cell phenotype by flow cytometry.
ATLL cells are more deeply polylobated flower cells and are HTLV-1 positive.

62390.recognize_zh: 左側為深染的小淋巴球構成的外套層（mantle zone），右側生發中心由大小不一的中心母細胞、中心細胞及散在的易染體巨噬細胞（tingible body macrophage）組成，細胞組成多樣，符合反應性濾泡。
features: Sharp transition from a mantle zone of small dark round lymphocytes (left) to a germinal center (right)
Germinal center composed of a polymorphous mix of centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli and smaller cleaved centrocytes
Scattered tingible-body macrophages with pale cytoplasm and occasional mitotic/apoptotic figures
Occasional plasma cell-like cells at the edge of the follicle
No monotonous population or sheets of atypical large cells
62390.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at high power shows a hyperplastic follicle with a well-defined mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes. The germinal center is polymorphous, containing an admixture of centroblasts, centrocytes, and tingible-body macrophages with apoptotic debris, consistent with preserved polarity and reactive activity. There is no monotonous atypical infiltrate in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive follicular hyperplasia, which can be seen in IgG4-related lymphadenopathy; IgG/IgG4 immunostains are needed to support that diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are monotonous, lack tingible-body macrophages and polarity, have attenuated mantles, and are BCL2-positive in germinal-center cells.
PTGC shows enlarged nodules in which mantle-zone small lymphocytes infiltrate and break up the germinal center rather than a sharply demarcated polymorphous GC.
NLPHL has large vague nodules of small lymphocytes containing scattered CD20+ LP (popcorn) cells rather than intact reactive germinal centers.

62326.recognize_zh: 活體染色（supravital，如 new methylene blue）下，許多紅血球內可見散在藍色細顆粒網狀物（網狀紅血球），另有個別紅血球在膜邊緣附著一顆較大、深藍色、圓形的包涵體，就是 Heinz 小體。
features: Numerous erythrocytes containing fine blue granular/filamentous precipitated RNA (reticulocytes)
Occasional red cells with a single larger, dark blue, round inclusion attached to the membrane periphery (Heinz body)
Heinz bodies are fewer and larger than reticulocyte granules and sit at the cell edge
Small platelet clump and a few pale unstained ghost-like cells in the background
Red cells otherwise round without prominent anisocytosis at this magnification
62326.describe_en: Supravital stain of a peripheral blood smear shows numerous reticulocytes containing fine blue-staining granular reticulum, indicating reticulocytosis. Occasional erythrocytes contain a single, larger, dark blue, round inclusion attached to the inner membrane at the cell periphery, consistent with a Heinz body (denatured hemoglobin). A small platelet clump and a few pale ghost cells are present. The combination of Heinz bodies and reticulocytosis is consistent with oxidative hemolysis, as seen in G6PD deficiency, unstable hemoglobins or oxidant drug exposure.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are small clustered basophilic iron granules visible on Wright stain and positive with Prussian blue, whereas Heinz bodies are invisible on Romanowsky stains and seen only with supravital stains.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single dense round DNA remnants visible on Wright stain, typically not membrane-attached, and indicate hyposplenism rather than oxidant injury.
HbH inclusions appear after prolonged brilliant cresyl blue incubation as numerous fine evenly dispersed golf-ball-like dots throughout the cell rather than one or two large peripheral bodies.
Basophilic stippling is diffuse fine to coarse punctate RNA granules seen on Wright stain (e.g., lead poisoning, thalassemia), not a large membrane-bound inclusion on supravital stain.

62134.recognize_zh: 九格圖中的細胞胞質充滿粗大嗜酸性顆粒，細胞核呈甜甜圈狀環形（ring-shaped nucleus），中央有淡染孔洞，符合環狀核嗜酸性球。
features: Granulocytes filled with coarse orange-red to purplish eosinophilic granules
Ring- or doughnut-shaped nuclei encircling a central pale cytoplasmic hole
Some cells with incompletely closed rings or band-like/bilobed nuclei (B, C, G)
Occasional granules with a darker purple hue, suggesting immature or mixed granulation
Normal-appearing background red cells; single cells shown at high magnification
62134.describe_en: This composite of high-power peripheral blood or aspirate fields shows multiple eosinophils with abundant coarse eosinophilic granules. Most cells have ring-shaped (doughnut) nuclei surrounding a central pale zone, while a few show band-like or partially segmented nuclei. Granules are occasionally darker purple, but no blast features are seen in the pictured cells. Findings are consistent with eosinophils with ring-shaped nuclei, a nonspecific nuclear variant that can be seen with drug exposure (such as adalimumab) and also in myeloid neoplasms, so clinical and hematologic correlation is required.

ddx.dx: Ring neutrophils in myeloid neoplasm or MDS
ddx.vs: Ring-nucleated neutrophils have fine lilac granules, whereas these cells carry coarse eosinophilic granules identifying the eosinophil lineage.
Ring sideroblasts are erythroid precursors with perinuclear iron granules seen only on Prussian blue stain, not granulocytes with doughnut-shaped nuclei.
Clonal eosinophilia shows sustained eosinophil counts with dysplastic features and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements rather than isolated nuclear variants after drug exposure.
Basophils have dark blue-black granules obscuring the nucleus rather than refractile orange-red eosinophilic granules.

62070.recognize_zh: 大部分紅血球失去中央淡染區、呈深染小圓形，符合球形紅血球的表現；但視野中大量細胞邊緣呈規則鋸齒狀皺縮（crenation），判讀時需與製片假影區分。
features: Predominance of round red cells without central pallor, many smaller and denser than expected
Widespread crenation with fine regular marginal spicules (echinocytic artifact) obscuring cell outlines
Anisocytosis with scattered larger, paler red cells
One larger, intensely magenta-staining round cell near the center of uncertain nature (possible artifact or polychromatic cell)
Clumped cells/possible platelet or leukocyte debris at upper right; no well-preserved leukocytes
62070.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small, densely staining round red cells lacking central pallor, with anisocytosis and scattered larger pale cells. Crenation with regular short spicules affects a large proportion of the red cells and, together with the thick, poorly spread field, makes reliable distinction between true spherocytes and artifactual loss of central pallor difficult. A single larger, intensely stained round cell is present but cannot be characterized at this resolution. Findings are suggestive of, but not diagnostic for, a spherocytic red cell population; review of a thin, well-prepared fresh smear is recommended.

ddx.dx: Crenation (echinocyte) artifact from delayed smear preparation
ddx.vs: Artifactual echinocytes are normal-sized with regular spicules throughout the slide, while spherocytes are smooth, small, and dense in the monolayer.
Spherocytes look identical; a positive DAT distinguishes immune hemolysis from hereditary spherocytosis.
HS is supported by a negative DAT, raised MCHC, family history and reduced EMA binding rather than by smear appearance alone.
PK deficiency shows prickle cells (small contracted echinocytes) after splenectomy rather than smooth spherocytes, and is confirmed by enzyme assay.

62006.recognize_zh: T2 軸切面 MRI 可見雙側額葉的高訊號病灶跨越胼胝體膝部（butterfly 型分布），並伴隨周邊水腫及側腦室前角受壓；深部、跨中線的病灶是原發性中樞神經系統淋巴瘤（PCNSL）常見的影像表現。
features: Axial T2-weighted MRI of the brain at the level of the lateral ventricles
Ill-defined bifrontal T2-hyperintense lesion, larger on the left, crossing the midline via the genu of the corpus callosum
Surrounding T2-hyperintense white-matter edema with mild effacement of the frontal horns
Focal intermediate-signal component near the midline anterior to the ventricles
Posterior brain parenchyma and occipital regions appear unremarkable
Non-morphologic image: histology is required for diagnosis
62006.describe_en: Axial T2-weighted MRI of the brain shows an ill-defined bifrontal T2-hyperintense mass, larger on the left, that straddles the genu of the corpus callosum with surrounding vasogenic edema and mild mass effect on the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles. The posterior hemispheres appear unremarkable in this slice. A deep periventricular lesion crossing the corpus callosum raises primary CNS lymphoma, glioblastoma, and demyelinating disease. Imaging findings are compatible with the clinical diagnosis of primary DLBCL of the CNS, which requires tissue (stereotactic biopsy, ideally before steroids) for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Glioblastoma typically shows necrosis with irregular ring enhancement and heterogeneous T2 signal, whereas PCNSL is usually solid and homogeneously enhancing with restricted diffusion; biopsy separates GFAP+ glial tumor from CD20+ large B cells.

Tumefactive demyelination often shows incomplete (open) ring enhancement and less mass effect, and biopsy shows macrophage-rich demyelination with axonal preservation rather than angiocentric large B cells.
Metastases are usually multiple, at the gray-white junction, with extensive edema, and biopsy shows cytokeratin+ epithelial cells.

61942.recognize_zh: 低倍下左側可見鱗狀上皮覆蓋的表面（扁桃腺樣黏膜），其下淋巴組織擴張、呈斑駁狀，濾泡界線模糊、濾泡間區增寬，是EBV再活化時淋巴組織反應性增生的結構線索。
features: Squamous mucosal surface along the left edge with an underlying crypt-like cleft, suggesting tonsillar/pharyngeal lymphoid tissue
Expanded lymphoid tissue with a mottled, vaguely nodular pattern and blurred follicular outlines
Widened interfollicular zones with paler, more polymorphous-appearing areas
No obvious necrosis or architectural effacement by a monotonous sheet at this magnification
Low image resolution limits assessment of cytology
61942.describe_en: Low-power section of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue covered by squamous epithelium (tonsil-like) shows an expanded lymphoid infiltrate with a mottled pattern, indistinct follicles and widened interfollicular areas. No discrete necrosis or monotonous sheets are identified at this magnification, although image resolution limits cytologic assessment. The architecture is compatible with a florid reactive lymphoid proliferation; in the appropriate context, correlation with EBER in situ hybridization supports EBV reactivation (infectious mononucleosis-like changes).

ddx.vs: cHL shows effacement with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background (CD30+, CD15+, weak PAX5, CD45-), whereas EBV reactivation preserves architecture with a polymorphous immunoblast continuum.
DLBCL forms monotonous sheets of large cells that efface the tissue, rather than a mottled partially preserved pattern with a spectrum of cell sizes.
Follicular hyperplasia has well-formed germinal centers with sharp mantle zones, while EBV-driven proliferation expands the interfollicular zone with immunoblasts.

61878.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片中腎絲球微血管與管周微血管腔內塞滿大型、核深染不規則的非典型淋巴細胞，血管外間質相對保留；內皮標記勾勒出含腫瘤細胞的血管腔，腫瘤細胞呈核陽性（EBER 樣）及細胞毒性顆粒陽性，符合血管內 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular to pleomorphic nuclei filling glomerular capillary loops
Tumor cells also distend peritubular capillaries between preserved renal tubules
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; mitotic-appearing and crushed nuclei within capillaries
Endothelial immunostain outlines capillary lumens containing the tumor cells, confirming an intravascular distribution
