Strong nuclear signal in large atypical cells (EBER-like pattern) and membranous/granular cytoplasmic staining with additional markers (antibodies not labeled)
Tubular epithelial injury with cytoplasmic vacuolization and interstitial edema
61878.describe_en: Composite of a renal biopsy. H&E sections (A-C) show large atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei distending glomerular capillary loops and peritubular capillaries, while the renal tubules are largely preserved apart from epithelial vacuolization and interstitial edema. An endothelial immunostain (D) outlines vascular lumens that contain the tumor cells, confirming an intravascular growth pattern. The large cells show strong nuclear positivity (E, pattern compatible with EBER in situ hybridization) and membranous or granular cytoplasmic staining with additional markers (F, G), likely representing NK-cell and cytotoxic markers, although the antibodies are not labeled. Findings are consistent with intravascular EBV-positive extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma involving the kidney.

ddx.vs: IVLBCL shares the intravascular growth pattern but is CD20/PAX5 positive and EBER negative, whereas this tumor has an EBV-positive NK/T-cell phenotype.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is a systemic leukemic disease with prominent peripheral blood and bone marrow involvement rather than a tumor largely confined to renal microvasculature.
Glomerulonephritis shows bland endocapillary neutrophils, monocytes and mesangial proliferation (CD68/MPO positive) with immune deposits, not large atypical EBER-positive lymphoid cells.
Carcinoma emboli are cohesive and keratin positive, unlike these discohesive lymphoid cells.

61814.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆巨核細胞，核分成多個彼此分離的圓形核葉（separated nuclear lobes，類似多核），周圍是嗜中性球與前驅細胞；分離核葉的發育不良巨核細胞在 GATA2 胚系突變相關髓系腫瘤中常見。
features: Large megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes resembling discrete nuclei
Abundant finely granular pale blue-violet cytoplasm
Nuclear lobes with relatively uniform size and no connecting chromatin bridges visible
Surrounding maturing myeloid cells including segmented neutrophils and myelocytes
Large fat globules in the aspirate background
61814.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte whose nucleus is divided into multiple widely separated, round, uniform lobes without obvious connecting chromatin, set in abundant finely granular cytoplasm, surrounded by maturing granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils, and fat globules. Megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes are a recognized dysplastic form and are frequently seen, along with small hypolobated megakaryocytes, in myelodysplastic neoplasms associated with germline GATA2 deficiency. A single megakaryocyte is insufficient for dysplasia quantification (≥10% of megakaryocytes). Findings are suggestive of megakaryocytic dysplasia, consistent with a myeloid neoplasm in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have lobes connected in a single contiguous lobulated nucleus, whereas dysplastic forms have discrete widely separated round lobes.
Osteoclasts have many uniform, separate oval nuclei each with a distinct nucleolus in coarsely granular cytoplasm and lie near bony trabecular spicules.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytic changes after chemotherapy or in megaloblastic anemia
ddx.vs: Reactive separated-lobe megakaryocytes occur transiently with drugs, B12/folate deficiency, or HIV, so clinical history and multilineage dysplasia assessment are required.
Multinucleated erythroid precursors are smaller with deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm and open megaloblastic chromatin.

61750.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD79a 染色中，大部分組織為陰性，只見少數棕色陽性 B 細胞聚集成小結節並沿血管周圍零星散布；陽性範圍比預期的脾邊緣區淋巴瘤擴張白髓更局限，需搭配其他切片判讀。
features: Very low-power field with small, discrete aggregates of CD79a-positive cells
Positive cells arranged around vascular/trabecular structures and scattered singly
Most of the parenchyma is CD79a-negative in this field
No expanded, confluent B-cell nodules evident at this magnification
61750.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemistry for CD79a shows a few small aggregates of positive B cells, some related to vascular structures, with scattered single positive cells in a largely negative background. This field does not demonstrate the expanded, confluent white pulp nodules or diffuse red pulp B-cell infiltration usually expected in splenic marginal zone lymphoma. The image may represent a limited area of involvement or residual B cells, so findings are only partially supportive and should be correlated with CD20 and H&E sections from the same case.

ddx.vs: HCL diffusely infiltrates the red pulp with CD79a/CD20-positive cells that are also annexin A1-, TRAP- and BRAF V600E-positive, with white pulp atrophy.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows diffuse cordal and sinusoidal red pulp infiltration rather than nodular white pulp involvement.
HSTCL infiltrates red pulp sinusoids with CD3-positive gamma-delta T cells that are CD79a-negative.

61686.recognize_zh: 這是一張流式細胞儀散點圖（CD3 對 CD5），不是形態學影像；主要的藍色族群 CD3 與 CD5 同時表現，另有一群 CD3 陽性但 CD5 較弱的洋紅色族群，可用來判讀 T 細胞族群的抗原表現。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD5-PB (y-axis), log scale, gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue population co-expressing CD3 (about 10^2) and CD5 (about 10^1), forming a tight diagonal cluster
Separate magenta CD3-positive population with dimmer to negative CD5 below the main cluster
Scattered red events overlapping the blue CD3+CD5+ cluster
Small green CD3-negative, CD5-negative population near the origin
61686.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD3 versus CD5 expression within the gated population. The predominant event cluster (blue) shows uniform co-expression of surface CD3 and CD5, consistent with a mature T-cell population, while a separate CD3-positive population with dimmer to absent CD5 (magenta) and a small CD3-negative, CD5-negative population (green) are also present. The colour legend and gating strategy are not provided, so assignment of populations as neoplastic versus residual normal cells cannot be made from this plot alone. Retained CD5 expression on the dominant T-cell population is in keeping with T-prolymphocytic leukemia, which usually expresses CD2, CD3, CD5 and bright CD7.

61622.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）骨髓抹片中，多個紅血球母細胞的核周圍排列著一圈藍色鐵顆粒，環繞核周至少三分之一以上，即為環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts），是 MDS-RS 的診斷關鍵。
features: Multiple erythroblasts with coarse blue iron granules arranged in a perinuclear ring
Granules encircle one-third or more of the nuclear circumference (ring sideroblast definition)
Other erythroblasts with few scattered granules or none
Background myeloid cells with pink nuclear counterstain and no iron
Scattered extracellular iron particles
61622.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue iron granules arranged in a perinuclear ring encircling at least one-third of the nucleus, diagnostic of ring sideroblasts. Other erythroblasts contain few scattered siderotic granules, and myeloid cells are iron-negative. Ring sideroblasts should be enumerated as a percentage of erythroid precursors; ≥15% (or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation) in the setting of cytopenia and exclusion of secondary causes supports myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, or isoniazid
ddx.vs: These reversible secondary causes also produce ring sideroblasts; clinical history, copper/zinc levels, and resolution after removal of the cause distinguish them.
Inherited forms (ALAS2, SLC25A38) present early in life with microcytosis and lack a clonal myeloid mutation such as SF3B1.
Normal sideroblasts have a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than coarse granules in a perinuclear ring.
Ring sideroblasts are identical; MDS/MPN-RS-T is separated by thrombocytosis ≥450×10^9/L and ET-like megakaryocytes.

61494.recognize_zh: 高倍視野內有多顆巨核細胞：數顆成熟大型、細胞質粉紅豐富，另有數顆較小、核深染且細胞質較少的較不成熟形式，背景為密集的紅血球系前驅細胞，符合 ITP 的巨核細胞增生（含幼稚型增加）。
features: Multiple megakaryocytes per high-power field, including large mature forms with abundant pink granular cytoplasm
Some smaller megakaryocytes with dark, less lobulated nuclei and scant cytoplasm, consistent with immature forms
No micromegakaryocytes with single round nuclei or tight clusters clearly identified
Dense background of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and maturing granulocytes
Interspersed fat spaces; some section tearing artifact
61494.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows cellular marrow with numerous megakaryocytes, including large mature forms with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and smaller forms with dark, less lobulated nuclei suggestive of immature megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are not tightly clustered, and no overt dysplastic micromegakaryocytes are identified. The background shows active erythropoiesis and granulopoiesis with interspersed adipocytes. Findings are consistent with increased megakaryopoiesis in response to peripheral platelet destruction, as in immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: Dysplastic micromegakaryocytes are small with a single round nucleus and mature cytoplasm, and dysplasia involves other lineages, whereas here immature forms coexist with normal large megakaryocytes.
AMKL shows sheets of megakaryoblasts with fibrosis and high blast count on aspirate or CD61/CD42b IHC, not scattered maturing megakaryocytes.
ET megakaryocytes are predominantly giant and hyperlobated in clusters with thrombocytosis.

61430.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中細胞核偏心、染色質塊狀、胞質嗜鹼性的小型淋巴漿細胞樣細胞（A），易被誤判為淋巴球增多；免疫染色 CD138+、lambda 限制、kappa−，並表現 CD20 與 cyclin D1，流式見 CD45 陰性族群（箭頭），符合漿細胞白血病。
features: PB (A): small to medium cells with round eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, mimicking lymphocytes
Tissue/clot (B): sheets of monotonous small plasmacytoid cells with round nuclei
IHC: CD20 membranous positive (C), cyclin D1 nuclear positive (D), CD138 strongly membranous (E)
Light chain restriction: lambda positive (F), kappa negative (G)
Flow (H): CD45-negative/dim, low side-scatter population (arrow) separate from CD45-bright cells
BM aspirate (I) with plasmacytoid cells (inset), CD138 (J) and lambda (K) positive
61430.describe_en: Composite figure: peripheral blood shows circulating small to medium cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm that can be mistaken for lymphocytes. Tissue and marrow sections show sheets of monotonous plasmacytoid cells that are CD138-positive and lambda light chain restricted (kappa negative), with aberrant CD20 and cyclin D1 expression. Flow cytometry shows a CD45-negative/dim low side-scatter population. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia with lymphoplasmacytoid morphology, and the CD20/cyclin D1 profile suggests t(11;14)(q13;q32), which should be confirmed by FISH.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5+CD23+ with bright CD45 and surface immunoglobulin, lacking CD138 and cytoplasmic light chain.
MCL is also cyclin D1-positive but expresses CD5, bright CD45 and surface immunoglobulin and is CD138-negative.
LPL has a mixture of small B cells and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein, rather than a pure CD138+ cyclin D1+ plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows predominant CD20+ B cells with CD138+ cells as a minor component and is cyclin D1-negative.

61430.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD20, CD138, cyclin D1, κ/λ

61366.recognize_zh: 中大型腫瘤細胞成片生長，細胞質豐富而淡染透亮，核為泡狀並具小核仁，其間有細緻粉紅膠原纖維將細胞分隔成小群（compartmentalizing sclerosis），配合縱膈腔部位，符合原發性縱膈大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large cells with abundant pale to clear, vacuolated cytoplasm
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with irregular contours, open chromatin and small nucleoli
Delicate interstitial collagen fibrils compartmentalizing tumor cells into small nests (alveolar pattern)
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic/hyperchromatic cells
No Reed-Sternberg-like cells or inflammatory background evident in this field
61366.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse proliferation of medium to large neoplastic cells with abundant pale to clear cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli and frequent mitoses. Fine interstitial collagen fibers divide the tumor into small compartments. A polymorphous inflammatory background is not appreciated. In a mediastinal mass, findings are consistent with primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD20, PAX5, CD23, variable CD30, MAL, PD-L1) with absence of CD15.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis (syncytial variant)
ddx.vs: CHL shows broad fibrous bands and Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background, with CD15+/CD30+ and weak PAX5 but loss of CD20/OCT2/BOB1.
Morphology and phenotype are intermediate, typically with sheets of pleomorphic cells combining strong CD20 with CD30/CD15 expression, requiring integrated IHC to separate.
Seminoma cells have clear glycogen-rich cytoplasm with fibrous septa and lymphocytes but express OCT3/4, SALL4 and CD117 and are CD45/CD20 negative.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm and express TdT, CD1a and CD3.

61302.recognize_zh: 這是一份全血球計數報告：血紅素 12.9 g/dL 與紅血球數 5.07×10^6/µL 正常，但 MCV 77.2 fL、MCH 25.4 pg 偏低，RDW 13.3% 正常，白血球與血小板正常，呈現「無貧血的單純小球性」變化。
features: WBC 7.31 ×10^3/µL with normal absolute differential; relative lymphocytosis 42.2% and Neu% 48.8% flagged
RBC 5.07 ×10^6/µL and HGB 12.9 g/dL within reference range (no anemia)
Low MCV 77.2 fL and low MCH 25.4 pg with normal MCHC 33.0 g/dL
Normal RDW-CV 13.3% and RDW-SD 39.5 fL
Platelets 266 ×10^3/µL with normal MPV and indices
61302.describe_en: Complete blood count shows a normal white cell count with a normal absolute differential (only relative neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages flagged), a normal hemoglobin of 12.9 g/dL, and a red cell count of 5.07 ×10^6/µL. Red cell indices show mild microcytosis (MCV 77.2 fL) and hypochromia (MCH 25.4 pg) with a normal MCHC and normal RDW. Platelet count and indices are normal. Isolated microcytosis without anemia and with a normal RDW is compatible with a hemoglobin variant such as Hb D trait, but coexisting thalassemia trait or early iron deficiency should be excluded with iron studies and hemoglobin analysis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency usually shows elevated RDW, a lower RBC count, and low ferritin, whereas here RDW is normal.
Thalassemia trait typically shows a higher RBC count and lower MCV (Mentzer index <13), with raised Hb A2 in beta-thalassemia trait; here the Mentzer index is about 15.
Chronic inflammation usually produces anemia with low serum iron and high ferritin, not normal hemoglobin with isolated microcytosis.

61238.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片裡可見數顆大型雙核細胞，兩個核成對排列、各有一個清楚的藍色大核仁，細胞質淡而豐富，周圍混有淋巴球、漿細胞與顆粒球，符合 Reed-Sternberg 細胞。
features: Several large binucleate cells, 3-4 times the size of small lymphocytes
Paired, mirror-image oval nuclei each containing a single prominent blue nucleolus
Vesicular to finely granular chromatin with smooth nuclear contours
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Mixed inflammatory background: small lymphocytes, plasma cells, segmented neutrophils and granulocytic precursors
61238.describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large binucleate cells with paired mirror-image nuclei, each containing a single conspicuous nucleolus, and abundant pale cytoplasm. These cells are present in a polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing granulocytes. There are no cohesive clusters to suggest carcinoma. Findings are consistent with Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma involving the bone marrow, to be confirmed on trephine biopsy with CD30/CD15 positivity and weak PAX5 expression.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have one lobulated nucleus without large inclusion-like nucleoli and have granular cytoplasm, a frequent aspirate pitfall.
Osteoclasts contain many (often >5) small uniform nuclei with small nucleoli in abundant granular cytoplasm rather than two large nuclei with macronucleoli.

ddx.dx: Immunoblasts in reactive or viral states (e.g., EBV)
ddx.vs: Immunoblasts can be binucleate but are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and are CD45+/CD20+ or CD3+, lacking the CD15+/CD45- RS phenotype.
ALCL cells occur in cohesive sheets with horseshoe nuclei and are ALK+ or EMA+ with T-cell markers, rather than scattered cells in a mixed background.

61174.recognize_zh: 切片中細胞片狀排列，形態一致，多數細胞核圓而偏位、染色質粗塊呈車輪狀，細胞質雙染性，只有部分細胞看得到核旁淡染區（hof），偶見雙核，這些漿細胞特徵在 H&E 上提示漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma）。
features: Monotonous sheets of plasma cells with little intervening stroma other than thin capillaries
Round eccentric nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin in a cartwheel pattern
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof in a minority of cells
Occasional binucleate plasma cells
Absence of admixed small lymphocytes, neutrophils or follicular structures
Low mitotic activity; nucleoli mostly inconspicuous
61174.describe_en: Tissue section shows a monotonous, diffuse proliferation of plasma cells arranged in sheets with a delicate capillary network. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse cartwheel chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with a perinuclear hof visible in only a subset; rare binucleate forms are present. Inflammatory cells and lymphoid follicles are not seen. Findings are consistent with plasmacytoma; confirmation of light-chain restriction by immunohistochemistry or ISH and staging for systemic plasma cell myeloma are recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; distinction from solitary plasmacytoma requires marrow examination, imaging and serum/urine protein studies.
These lymphomas show a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a CD20-positive B-cell component.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli, brisk mitoses and frequent EBV positivity.
Inflammatory lesions contain polyclonal plasma cells mixed with histiocytes and lymphocytes rather than monomorphic sheets.

61110.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片與抹片中漿細胞增多，並可見大量長方形、針狀或菱形的結晶（抹片上呈淡藍或無色折光棒狀，H&E 呈嗜酸性），免疫染色 kappa 陰性、lambda 強陽性且結晶本身著色，證實為 lambda 輕鏈結晶沉積於骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm on aspirate
Numerous intracellular and extracellular elongated rod-shaped, needle-like and rhomboid crystals (pale blue to colorless, refractile on Wright-Giemsa)
H&E biopsy: eosinophilic rectangular/rhomboid crystalline material within and between hematopoietic cells
Crystals indent or distort the cells containing them
Kappa immunostain negative; lambda immunostain strongly positive in plasma cells and in the crystalline rods (lambda restriction)
61110.describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow biopsy shows plasma cells admixed with eosinophilic rhomboid and rectangular crystalline inclusions. Aspirate smears show increased plasma cells, many containing or associated with elongated needle-shaped and rod-like refractile crystals, with numerous crystals also present extracellularly. Immunohistochemistry shows absent kappa staining and strong lambda staining of both the plasma cells and the crystalline material. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with lambda light chain crystal inclusions; evaluation for crystal-storing histiocytosis and light chain crystalline nephropathy/Fanconi syndrome is suggested.

ddx.vs: In CSH the crystals are stored within CD68+ CD163+ histiocytes rather than CD138+ light-chain-restricted plasma cells, although both may coexist.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm with fibrillary striations rather than discrete refractile rod-shaped crystals that stain for immunoglobulin light chain.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal hexagonal crystals derived from eosinophil galectin-10 and lack light-chain immunoreactivity.
Auer rods are thin MPO-positive azurophilic rods in myeloblasts, whereas these are larger crystals in lambda-positive plasma cells.

61046.recognize_zh: 骨髓中兩顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞核小而偏位，淡藍色胞質充滿纖維狀、像揉皺紙張（crumpled tissue paper）的條紋，這是戈謝細胞（Gaucher cell）的典型外觀。
features: Large macrophages with abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm
Fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasmic texture
Small, round-to-oval eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin
A few small cytoplasmic vacuoles, no discrete foamy lipid droplets
Background of red cells and smudged/fragmented cells, one showing fibrillar strands at the top
61046.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large histiocytes with small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm displaying a fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture. The cytoplasm is not foamy or finely vacuolated, and no hemophagocytosis is seen. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; the diagnosis should be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity and GBA1 genetic testing.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically near-identical and are separated by the underlying disease and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble, uniformly vacuolated cytoplasm rather than striated fibrillar cytoplasm.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granular ceroid pigment rather than a pale fibrillary texture.

60982.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下，增厚不規則的骨小樑之間，髓腔被瀰漫、交織、呈流水狀的纖維網取代，造血細胞幾乎消失，符合骨髓纖維化的高度網狀纖維增生；本圖對比偏淡，精確分級受限。
features: Thickened, irregular and interconnecting bony trabeculae (osteosclerosis)
Diffuse dense meshwork of intersecting fibers throughout the intertrabecular spaces, with streaming bundles
Markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity with dilated spaces and scattered fat vacuoles
Staining contrast is weak (reddish-brown rather than crisp black fibers), limiting precise MF grading
60982.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin shows thickened, irregular trabeculae with the intertrabecular marrow replaced by a diffuse, dense, intersecting fiber network with streaming bundles. Hematopoietic cells are sparse. Although the staining contrast in this photomicrograph is suboptimal for precise grading, the diffuse dense fiber network with osteosclerosis suggests high-grade reticulin fibrosis (MF-2 to MF-3). Findings are consistent with fibrotic-stage primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Shows hypercellular marrow with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and at most MF-1 reticulin, not diffuse dense fibrosis with osteosclerosis.
Reticulin pattern is identical; distinction depends on prior documented PV or ET.
Features acute onset with increased CD34-positive blasts and dysplastic small megakaryocytes in the fibrotic marrow, without prior MPN and usually without splenomegaly.

ddx.dx: Reactive fibrosis (e.g., hyperparathyroidism, infection, autoimmune myelofibrosis)
ddx.vs: Typically focal/peritrabecular or low-grade reticulin with preserved hematopoiesis and no atypical megakaryocytes or MPN driver mutation.

60918.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一大片淡粉紅色、界線不清的上皮樣組織球聚集（非乾酪性肉芽腫），插圖可見多核巨細胞（箭頭）；抗酸染色下組織球內滿是洋紅色成團的桿菌（箭頭），符合瀰漫性鳥型分枝桿菌複合群（MAC）感染。
features: Large, poorly formed aggregate of pale eosinophilic epithelioid histiocytes replacing marrow
No caseous necrosis within the granulomatous area
Inset: histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells (arrows)
Acid-fast stain: numerous magenta-staining bacilli packed within histiocyte cytoplasm, forming clusters (arrows)
Residual hematopoietic marrow and fat surrounding the lesion
60918.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine shows a large, ill-defined, noncaseating granulomatous aggregate composed of sheets of pale epithelioid histiocytes that replaces a substantial portion of the intertrabecular space, with multinucleated giant cells seen at higher power; residual hematopoiesis and fat surround the lesion. The acid-fast stain demonstrates abundant magenta acid-fast bacilli clustered within histiocytes. Findings are consistent with disseminated mycobacterial infection with marrow granulomas, compatible with Mycobacterium avium complex in the appropriate clinical setting; culture or molecular identification is required for speciation.

ddx.vs: TB granulomas are usually well formed with caseous necrosis and few bacilli, whereas MAC in immunocompromised hosts forms loose histiocytic sheets packed with bacilli; culture/PCR is definitive.
Histoplasma yeasts are small intracellular organisms that are GMS/PAS positive and not acid-fast.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well formed and lack organisms on AFB and fungal stains.
Granulomas accompany CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and no acid-fast organisms are seen.

60854.recognize_zh: S-100 免疫染色中，左側一大片細胞核卵圓、帶核溝、胞質豐富的蘭格漢斯細胞同時呈細胞核與胞質陽性，與右側陰性的小淋巴球區域分界清楚，支持 LCH（但 S-100 不具專一性，需搭配 CD1a/langerin）。
features: Large sheet of lesional cells on the left with moderate-to-strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S-100 staining
Lesional cells with abundant cytoplasm and oval, folded/grooved nuclei visible through the stain
Negative small lymphocytes forming the background on the right
Scattered individual S-100 positive cells at the edge of the infiltrate
Occasional small clear spaces within the infiltrate
60854.describe_en: S-100 immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows a sheet of large lesional cells with abundant cytoplasm and oval, grooved nuclei displaying moderate to strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining, sharply demarcated from S-100-negative small lymphocytes. Scattered single positive cells extend into the adjacent lymphoid tissue. S-100 positivity supports a dendritic/Langerhans cell phenotype and, together with CD1a and langerin, is consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are also strongly S-100 positive, but they are much larger with emperipolesis and are CD1a/langerin negative.
IDC sarcoma is S-100 positive but CD1a and langerin negative, with spindle-to-ovoid cells in a paracortical distribution.
Melanoma is S-100 positive but also SOX10, Melan-A and HMB-45 positive, and CD1a/langerin negative.

60790.recognize_zh: 高倍下大型淋巴樣細胞瀰漫片狀排列，核為多葉狀（polylobated）或卵圓、染色質呈泡狀並有多個靠近核膜的小核仁（中心母細胞樣），胞質淡且帶空泡，散在凋亡碎片，符合骨原發大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with nuclei two to three times a small lymphocyte
Oval to multilobated (polylobated) nuclei with vesicular chromatin
Multiple small membrane-bound nucleoli (centroblastic cytology)
Pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered apoptotic cells and karyorrhectic debris; thin fibrous septa
60790.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a diffuse proliferation of large atypical lymphoid cells arranged in sheets separated by thin fibrous septa. The cells have oval to polylobated nuclei with vesicular chromatin, multiple small peripheral nucleoli and pale, vacuolated cytoplasm. Scattered apoptotic bodies and nuclear debris are present, while no cohesive epithelial nests or osteoid formation are seen in this field. Findings, together with CD20 positivity, are consistent with primary bone diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with centroblastic morphology.

ddx.vs: Composed of smaller uniform round cells with fine chromatin and PAS-positive glycogen, CD99 membranous and CD45/CD20 negative.
Forms cohesive nests with defined cell borders and is cytokeratin positive, CD45 negative.
Shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, cohesive sinusoidal growth and strong CD30, lacking CD20.
Polymorphous inflammatory cells with neutrophils and plasma cells rather than monotonous sheets of large atypical cells.

60598.recognize_zh: 芽細胞旁邊有多個細胞質充滿粗大、深紫黑色嗜鹼性顆粒且顆粒覆蓋細胞核的細胞，插圖箭頭指出不成熟細胞的顆粒；芽細胞合併異常嗜鹼性分化，符合急性嗜鹼性白血病。
features: Blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular blue cytoplasm
Several cells packed with coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules obscuring the nucleus
Granules extend over the nuclear outline and to the cell periphery; nuclear detail barely visible
Inset: immature cell with a more open nuclear area and coarse basophilic granules (arrow)
60598.describe_en: Peripheral blood (or marrow) smear shows blasts with fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm admixed with abnormal immature basophils whose cytoplasm is packed with coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus. The inset highlights an immature basophilic precursor with coarse granules. In the absence of a BCR::ABL1 fusion or other defining genetic abnormality, and with confirmation by toluidine blue metachromasia and immunophenotype (CD123+, CD203c+, CD117-, tryptase negative or weak), findings are consistent with acute basophilic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: Also shows basophilia with blasts but carries BCR::ABL1 and usually a preceding chronic phase with left-shifted granulocytes.
Mast cells have round/oval nuclei with less nuclear overlap by granules, and are CD117-bright, tryptase-positive and often KIT D816V, unlike CD117-negative basophil blasts.
APL granules are azurophilic red-purple with Auer rod bundles and strong MPO, not coarse metachromatic basophilic granules.

ddx.dx: AML with t(6;9) DEK::NUP214 or inv(3)
ddx.vs: May show accompanying basophilia, but defining cytogenetics establish these as genetically defined entities.

60662.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中，有些顆粒減少、核分葉不良（pseudo-Pelger 樣）的異常顆粒球細胞質內可見細長粉紅色棒狀 Auer 小體（黑、藍箭頭），同時伴有胞質含空泡、核染色質細緻的母細胞，代表骨髓性（myeloid）來源的急性白血病。
features: Myeloid blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli/nuclear clearing, and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm, some with a small cytoplasmic bleb
Thin, needle-like pink Auer rods within the cytoplasm of blasts and of a more mature granulocytic cell
Dysplastic granulocytes with hypogranular pale pink cytoplasm and hyposegmented or clumped nuclei (red arrows)
Auer rod in a cell with a partially condensed nucleus, indicating maturing neoplastic granulocyte
Background red cells without significant schistocytes
60662.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating myeloid blasts with fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. Several cells contain slender, needle-shaped Auer rods, including a hypogranular granulocyte with a relatively condensed nucleus (panel A) and blasts (panels B and C). Accompanying neutrophils are dysplastic, with hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation. No bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) are seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, showing Auer rods in dysplastic granulocytes.

ddx.vs: APL shows hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells), whereas these cells are hypogranular with single rods; PML::RARA testing is definitive.
Auer rods can occur in MDS-EB (formerly EB-2), so the separation depends on the blast count (≥20% for AML) rather than on the rods themselves.
Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods, and the accompanying granulocytic dysplasia points to a myeloid process; MPO would be negative in ALL.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, irregular peripheral cytoplasmic patches, not sharp pink needle-shaped rods.

60726.recognize_zh: 皮膚上有多處色素沉著斑塊與一顆紫紅色結節性腫瘤；皮膚切片 H&E 為真皮內瀰漫的非典型淋巴球浸潤，免疫染色呈大片 T 細胞陽性並向表皮延伸，臨床加病理組合符合皮膚型成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤 (ATLL)，需以 HTLV-1 血清學確認。
features: Panel A (clinical photo): multiple hyperpigmented patches/plaques on the trunk with a central violaceous dome-shaped nodule
Panel B H&E (scanning power): dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate beneath the epidermis
Panel B IHC: diffuse strong staining of the dermal infiltrate with focal epidermal involvement (Pautrier-like clusters) for a T-cell marker (labels not legible)
Panel B IHC (right half): weaker/patchy staining with other markers showing loss or limited expression in the infiltrate
High-power cytology not shown; cellular atypia cannot be assessed at this magnification
60726.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple hyperpigmented patches and plaques on the skin with a central violaceous nodular tumor. Skin biopsy at scanning magnification demonstrates a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate that is diffusely positive for a T-cell marker, with focal epidermotropic clusters, while additional immunostains (labels not legible in the figure) are only focally positive, suggesting antigen loss. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In context, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires HTLV-1 serology/proviral integration and CD4+/CD25+ phenotype.

ddx.vs: MF and cutaneous ATLL overlap histologically; ATLL is distinguished by HTLV-1 positivity, strong CD25 expression and often hypercalcemia or circulating flower cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD30+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: cALCL consists of sheets of large CD30+ (>75%) anaplastic cells presenting as solitary ulcerated nodules without widespread patches.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Diagnosed only after excluding HTLV-1 infection and MF by clinical and serologic correlation.

60534.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，小至中型淋巴細胞核輪廓稍不規則、周圍常有透明暈，與大量細胞核卵圓淡染、細胞質豐富粉紅的類上皮組織球小群交錯排列；未見成形肉芽腫或 Reed-Sternberg 細胞，符合 Lennert 淋巴瘤的細胞組成。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to mildly irregular nuclei, condensed to slightly open chromatin, and frequent clear perinuclear halos
Scattered slightly larger atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli
Numerous small clusters and sheets of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated pale nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional mitotic figure among the lymphoid cells
No well-formed granulomas, necrosis, or Reed-Sternberg-like cells in this field
60534.describe_en: High-power view shows a diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to mildly irregular nuclei, many with clear perinuclear cytoplasmic halos, and scattered slightly larger atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and occasional mitoses. These are intimately admixed with numerous small, non-cohesive clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with oval pale nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. No discrete granulomas, necrosis, or Reed-Sternberg cells are identified. Findings are consistent with the lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, to be confirmed by T-cell immunophenotyping and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Mixed cellularity Hodgkin lymphoma contains diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells with eosinophils and plasma cells, whereas here the atypia lies in the small-to-medium T cells.
Toxoplasmosis shows small epithelioid clusters within and around hyperplastic follicles with monocytoid B cells and no cytologic atypia of T cells.
THRLBCL has scattered large B cells (CD20+, BCL6+) in a background of reactive small T cells and non-epithelioid histiocytes.
AITL features clear neoplastic cells around arborizing high endothelial venules with TFH phenotype and FDC expansion.

60470.recognize_zh: CD10 免疫染色下，成片的大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜與細胞質陽性，核呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，細胞間有淡藍色纖維血管間隔；大細胞 CD10 陽性代表生發中心來源，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤 3B 級的大細胞群。
features: Sheets of large cells with membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD10 staining
Large round to oval vesicular nuclei with single conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale cytoplasm outlined by the stain
Thin CD10-negative fibrovascular septa traversing the field
Staining intensity is moderate and somewhat heterogeneous
60470.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemical stain shows sheets of large neoplastic cells with moderate membranous and granular cytoplasmic positivity. The cells have large vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm, and are separated by thin CD10-negative fibrovascular septa. CD10 expression indicates a germinal center B-cell phenotype; in the context of a follicular growth pattern composed of solid sheets of centroblasts, findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, GCB type
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows the same CD10+ large cells but lacks a residual CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic cell meshwork.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small nucleoli, a starry-sky pattern, BCL2 negativity and ~100% Ki-67.
Pleomorphic MCL is CD10-negative, CD5-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
Grade 3A still contains admixed centrocytes, whereas grade 3B follicles consist of solid sheets of centroblasts; CD10 may be lost in 3B.

60278.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆嗜中性球細胞質內塞滿多個 2–4 μm 的卵圓形小體，每個周圍有透明暈、內側有新月形深染區，是被吞噬的莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）酵母型；在 HIV 未控制病人出現即代表播散性感染。
features: Neutrophils with segmented or band-like nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm
One neutrophil contains multiple small (about 2-4 μm) oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms
Each yeast has a clear halo (pseudocapsule) with an eccentric crescent of dark-staining chromatin
Organisms are uniform in size without budding on a broad base
Background red cells and occasional platelets; no extracellular organisms clearly identified
60278.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils, one of which contains multiple small, uniform oval intracytoplasmic organisms measuring approximately 2-4 μm. Each organism has a surrounding clear halo and an eccentric crescent of dark-staining material, characteristic of Histoplasma capsulatum yeast forms. The adjacent neutrophils show pale granular cytoplasm without definite organisms, and red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. In a patient with advanced HIV infection, findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation with fungal culture, urine/serum Histoplasma antigen or GMS staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack the clear halo, and are usually within macrophages rather than neutrophils.
Candida forms pseudohyphae and budding yeasts, and Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 μm) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Toxic granules are fine dark azurophilic dots and Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches, neither having a halo or internal crescent structure.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission and show a central transverse septum, which histoplasma lacks; travel to Southeast Asia is a clue.

60150.recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖中，箭頭指向一條延長的 9 號染色體 der(9) 與一條明顯變短的 22 號染色體（費城染色體，Ph），代表 t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) 形成 BCR-ABL1 融合基因。
features: G-banded karyotype arranged 1–22 plus sex chromosomes; two X chromosomes, no Y (female)
Arrow on chromosome 9 marks the derivative 9 carrying translocated 22q material (lengthened 9q)
Arrow on chromosome 22 marks a shortened derivative 22, the Philadelphia chromosome
No other obvious numerical or structural abnormality evident at this resolution
60150.describe_en: This G-banded karyotype shows a female complement with a reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 9 and 22, indicated by arrows: a derivative chromosome 9 and a shortened derivative chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome). No additional abnormalities are apparent at this banding resolution. The karyotype would be reported as 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2), which generates the BCR-ABL1 fusion and is consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: The identical t(9;22) occurs in B-ALL (often p190 BCR-ABL1), so morphology, flow cytometry and blast count, not the karyotype, distinguish it from CML.
Some CML cases have a normal-appearing karyotype or complex variant translocations, requiring FISH or RT-PCR to detect BCR-ABL1.

ddx.dx: CML in accelerated/blast phase with additional abnormalities
ddx.vs: Additional changes such as +8, i(17q), +19 or a second Ph would indicate clonal evolution, and none are evident here.

60086.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中倍下以芽細胞為主，下方中央有一顆細胞質帶空泡、兩個核葉完全分開的異常巨核細胞（separated nuclear lobes），部分顆粒球顆粒減少；芽細胞增加加上巨核系發育不良，符合 inv(3) AML 的抹片表現。
features: Numerous blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional visible nucleoli
Dysplastic megakaryocyte (bottom center) with two widely separated round nuclear lobes and vacuolated granular cytoplasm
Occasional hypogranular maturing myeloid cells
Scattered small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors with dense nuclei
Red cells unremarkable at this magnification
60086.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a predominance of blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, admixed with scattered erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and hypogranular myeloid cells. A dysplastic megakaryocyte at the bottom center has two widely separated round nuclear lobes and vacuolated granular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified. With 72% blasts, multilineage dysplasia and inv(3)(q21q26.2), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)/MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia is shared; cytogenetic detection of inv(3)/t(3;3) takes precedence and defines the MECOM-rearranged entity.
Morphology and even inv(3) can occur after therapy; a history of prior cytotoxic treatment is the distinguishing factor.
Megaloblastic change can produce multinucleated megakaryocytes and dysplasia but blasts are not increased and B12/folate levels are low.

60022.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮被成片中型、核質比高的腫瘤細胞取代，細胞核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻並有明顯核仁，可見核分裂與凋亡小體，腫瘤細胞在殘存膠原束之間浸潤；這種單調的母細胞樣浸潤需以免疫染色排除淋巴瘤，才可確立骨髓肉瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells infiltrating between residual dermal collagen bundles
High N:C ratio with oval to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei
Fine to vesicular chromatin with small distinct nucleoli
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Scant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm; no obvious eosinophilic myelocytes identified
60022.describe_en: Skin biopsy at higher power shows the dermis replaced by diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells infiltrating between residual collagen bundles. The cells have a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, oval to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin, and distinct small nucleoli, with scant pale cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified. The morphology is that of a high-grade blastic neoplasm, and immunohistochemistry is required for lineage; with myeloid marker expression (MPO, CD33, lysozyme), the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are often larger with vesicular chromatin and are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO negative.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has a similar starry-sky blastic look with finer chromatin and less conspicuous nucleoli, but is TdT positive with B- or T-lineage markers and MPO negative.
BPDCN typically spares the epidermis with a grenz zone and involves dermis similarly, but is CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4 positive and MPO negative.
Merkel cell carcinoma shows salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and CK20 perinuclear dot staining.

29814.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁的纖維組織內（圓圈處）可見數個卵圓形、具透明折光外殼的蟲卵，卵內含嗜鹼性顆粒狀的毛蚴（miracidium），周圍有纖維化反應，符合血吸蟲卵（schistosomal eggs）。
features: Cluster of oval parasite eggs, roughly 60-100 micron, with thin refractile hyaline shells (circled)
Egg contents granular and basophilic, consistent with developing miracidia
Eggs embedded in fibrous stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula
Minimal surrounding granulomatous or eosinophilic inflammation in this field
Lateral or terminal spine not clearly identified in this plane of section
29814.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E; low and high power) shows a cluster of oval eggs with thin refractile shells containing granular basophilic embryonated contents, embedded in fibrous stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula. There is only a mild stromal reaction without a well-formed granuloma in these fields, and the surrounding marrow is hypocellular with fat. A spine is not definitively visible in this plane of section, limiting speciation. Findings are consistent with schistosomal eggs involving the bone marrow; species identification relies on spine position, stool/urine ova examination and serology.

ddx.vs: Paragonimus eggs are operculated with a thickened shell and lack a spine, whereas schistosome eggs are non-operculated with a lateral or terminal spine.
Coccidioides spherules are round with a thick wall containing small uniform endospores and are GMS positive.
Histiocytes have a nucleus and fibrillary or foamy cytoplasm without a refractile acellular shell.
Calcified material is amorphous and dark purple without an organized shell containing embryonic cells.

27766.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片顯著過度增生、以顆粒球系為主，並有小型、核分葉不良的發育異常巨核細胞（箭頭）；抹片中嗜中性球核分葉不良、細胞質顆粒減少，並伴有未成熟顆粒球——顆粒球增生合併明顯的發育異常，是非典型慢性骨髓性白血病（aCML）的重點。
features: Left (BM biopsy, H&E): markedly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic predominance
Left: small, hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes (arrows)
Right (smear): neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation, including hypolobated and bizarre forms
Right: hypogranular neutrophil cytoplasm (dysgranulopoiesis)
Right: circulating immature granulocytes (promyelocytes/myelocytes) with occasional larger immature cells; no basophilia evident
27766.describe_en: The bone marrow trephine (left) is markedly hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and scattered small dysplastic megakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei (arrows). The smear (right) shows leukocytosis composed of neutrophils and immature granulocytes; neutrophils display prominent dysplasia with hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation. Basophils are not increased and monocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia), provided BCR::ABL1 is absent and blasts are below 20%.

ddx.vs: CML shows basophilia, a myelocyte 'bulge' without significant dysgranulopoiesis, small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes, and BCR::ABL1.
CNL has mature, non-dysplastic neutrophils with toxic granulation, <10% immature granulocytes and CSF3R mutation.
CMML requires persistent absolute monocytosis (≥0.5 × 10^9/L and ≥10% of WBC), which is not seen in this field.
Reactive states show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without pseudo-Pelger-Huët or hypogranular neutrophils or dysplastic megakaryocytes.

18486.recognize_zh: 這是 CIBMTR 的 Kaplan-Meier 存活曲線（非形態學影像）：HLA 相合手足異體移植治療濾泡性淋巴瘤，依化療敏感性與前處置強度分四組；化療敏感組（約 62–66%）六年存活優於化療抗性組（約 45–51%），P = 0.011。
features: Kaplan-Meier curves of probability of survival (%) over 6 years after HLA-matched sibling allo-HSCT for follicular lymphoma, 1998-2007
Four groups: chemosensitive RIC (N=388), chemosensitive myeloablative (N=351), chemoresistant RIC (N=64), chemoresistant myeloablative (N=85)
Chemosensitive groups plateau around 62-66% at 6 years
Chemoresistant groups fall to roughly 45-51% at 6 years
Log-rank P = 0.011; CIBMTR data
18486.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows CIBMTR Kaplan-Meier survival curves after HLA-matched sibling donor allogeneic transplantation for follicular lymphoma, stratified by disease chemosensitivity and conditioning intensity. Patients with chemosensitive disease had approximately 62-66% survival at 6 years regardless of conditioning, whereas those with chemoresistant disease had approximately 45-51% survival (P = 0.011). Reduced-intensity conditioning performed at least as well as myeloablative conditioning, indicating that disease status before transplant, rather than conditioning intensity, is the dominant determinant of outcome.

16886.recognize_zh: 中央一顆嗜中性球的細胞核分成六葉以上（hypersegmented），背景紅血球大小不一且有大卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocytes）與淚滴狀細胞，是惡性貧血等巨母紅血球性貧血的典型組合。
features: Large neutrophil with a hypersegmented nucleus of six or more discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Lobes contain dense, clumped mature chromatin; cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes)
Occasional teardrop-shaped and irregular poikilocytes
Red cells largely lack increased central pallor abnormalities; no nucleated red cells in this field
16886.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes) and occasional teardrop and irregularly shaped poikilocytes. A single neutrophil in the center displays a hypersegmented nucleus with at least six lobes joined by thin filaments. Platelets are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, in this case attributed to pernicious anemia (vitamin B12 deficiency).

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; distinction requires serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid (elevated only in B12 deficiency) and intrinsic factor/parietal cell antibodies.
MDS may show macrocytosis but typically has hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils rather than true hypersegmentation, with normal B12/folate levels.
Drug-related changes mimic megaloblastic anemia morphologically and are identified by medication history with normal vitamin levels.
This benign autosomal dominant trait shows hypersegmented neutrophils without macro-ovalocytes, anemia or cytopenias.

15798.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞的細胞質內吞入多個有核細胞與紅血球（hemophagocytosis）；骨髓切片以組織球標記（如 CD163）染色，可見大量陽性組織球散布，部分內含被吞噬的細胞，符合噬血性淋巴組織球增生症（HLH）。
features: Panel A (BM aspirate): activated macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing several engulfed nucleated cells (likely erythroid precursors/lymphocytes) and red cells
Phagocytosed cells appear as dark round nuclei within clear phagocytic vacuoles
Macrophage nucleus eccentric and compressed by ingested material
Panel B (BM biopsy IHC, likely CD163): markedly increased brown-staining interstitial histiocytes with dendritic processes, some enlarged with phagocytosed cells
Background marrow with fat spaces and mixed hematopoietic cells
15798.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows activated macrophages whose cytoplasm contains multiple engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells and red cells within phagocytic vacuoles. Immunohistochemistry for a histiocytic marker (likely CD163) on the core biopsy highlights a markedly increased population of interstitial histiocytes, several of which are enlarged and contain phagocytosed cells. Hemophagocytosis itself is neither sensitive nor specific; findings are consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context (HLH-2004 criteria, including fever, cytopenias, hyperferritinemia, hypertriglyceridemia/hypofibrinogenemia, elevated sIL-2R and low NK activity).

ddx.vs: Isolated hemophagocytic macrophages are common after transfusion or infection and do not constitute HLH without the clinical and laboratory criteria.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows cytologically malignant histiocytes with nuclear atypia and mitoses forming sheets, rather than bland activated macrophages.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100 positive and show intact lymphocytes passing through cytoplasm (emperipolesis) without destruction, usually in lymph nodes.
Morphology of the macrophages is identical; an underlying T/NK or EBV-positive lymphoma must be sought with IHC, EBER and clonality studies.

13494.recognize_zh: 關節液抹片中布滿大量細長針狀結晶，彼此交錯並聚成一束一束，部分與嗜中性球重疊，背景為蛋白性物質與許多嗜中性球；大量針狀結晶伴急性發炎，符合痛風的尿酸鈉（MSU）結晶，確認需以偏光顯微鏡看到強負雙折射。
features: Innumerable slender needle-shaped crystals, extracellular and overlying cells, forming a dense criss-crossing meshwork
Crystals aggregating into parallel bundles (upper and center of field)
Many neutrophils with segmented nuclei, several with vacuolated cytoplasm
A macrophage with blue-gray cytoplasm and a cell containing phagocytosed pyknotic nuclear fragments
Proteinaceous, vacuolated background
13494.describe_en: Wright-stained synovial fluid preparation shows a neutrophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate embedded in proteinaceous material with innumerable slender needle-shaped crystals, both extracellular and overlying cells, many aggregated into parallel bundles. A macrophage and a phagocyte containing pyknotic nuclear fragments are also present. No organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with monosodium urate crystals in acute gouty arthritis; confirmation by compensated polarized light microscopy showing strongly negatively birefringent needles is recommended, and concurrent septic arthritis should be excluded by culture.

ddx.vs: CPPD crystals are short rhomboid or rod-shaped and weakly positively birefringent, not long, fine, strongly negatively birefringent needles.
Steroid crystals are irregular, blunt or jagged and of variable size, with a history of recent intra-articular injection.
Cholesterol crystals are large flat rectangular plates with notched corners rather than slender needles.
Septic arthritis also yields a neutrophil-rich fluid but shows organisms on Gram stain or culture and lacks abundant crystals; the two may coexist.

11190.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中大量棕色陽性的漿細胞呈間質散在與小團聚集，許多細胞中央有大型透明圓形包涵體、周圍一圈染色，像戒指般，代表胞質內充滿免疫球蛋白的 Russell body，提示漿細胞增生。
features: Numerous immunoreactive (brown) plasma cells scattered interstitially and in small clusters
Many positive cells contain large round clear globular inclusions with a rim of staining (Russell bodies)
Positive cells vary in size, some markedly enlarged by the inclusions
Negative background hematopoietic cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Fat spaces preserved; the specific antibody is not labeled in the image
11190.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain for a plasma cell marker (antibody not specified; pattern compatible with CD138 or a light chain) highlights increased plasma cells distributed interstitially and in small clusters. Many plasma cells contain large, round cytoplasmic globular inclusions consistent with Russell bodies, producing a ring-like staining pattern. The remaining hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings support a plasma cell proliferation with Russell body formation; quantification of plasma cells, kappa/lambda light chain staining to demonstrate monotypia and correlation with serum paraprotein are needed to establish plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are perivascular and polytypic for kappa and lambda, whereas myeloma shows clustered or sheet-like monotypic plasma cells often exceeding 10% of cellularity.
LPL shows paratrabecular/interstitial small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Signet ring cell carcinoma or lipid-laden macrophages
ddx.vs: Signet ring cells are keratin-positive with mucin vacuoles and macrophages are CD68/CD163 positive, while Russell body cells are CD138 and light chain positive.

3318.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，只有大型異型細胞呈強而均勻的棕色細胞質（含膜）陽性，周圍小型造血細胞呈藍色陰性，顯示大細胞呈叢狀侵犯骨髓；圖中未標示抗體，推測為 ALCL 的 CD30 或 ALK 染色。
features: Large atypical cells with strong, uniform brown cytoplasmic and membranous immunoreactivity
Positive cells arranged in clusters and small sheets, some with sinusoidal-like distribution
Nuclei of positive cells are irregular or reniform with hematoxylin counterstain and no clear nuclear staining
Small background hematopoietic cells and stromal cells are negative (blue)
Specific antibody is not labeled in the image
3318.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy highlights clusters and sheets of large atypical cells with strong, diffuse cytoplasmic and membranous positivity, while the small background hematopoietic and stromal cells are negative. The nuclei of the positive cells appear unstained, and some are reniform. The antibody is not specified in the image; the pattern is compatible with CD30, or with ALK in a variant fusion showing cytoplasm-restricted staining. In the context of the title, the findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CD30-positive Hodgkin cells are scattered singly in a fibrotic mixed background rather than forming cohesive clusters, and they are ALK negative and CD15 positive.
Carcinoma clusters can stain similarly with keratin or EMA, but they are negative for CD30, ALK and T-cell markers.
Mast cells are smaller spindle-shaped cells in paratrabecular aggregates and do not show the large anaplastic nuclei seen here.
If the stain is CD30, ALK-positive and ALK-negative ALCL cannot be separated without an ALK immunostain.

3894.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中右上方的嗜中性球核分成約 8 葉以上、中央那顆也有 5 葉，旁邊一顆正常嗜酸性球作對照，呈現典型的過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），提示維生素 B12／葉酸缺乏。
features: Neutrophil (upper right) with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus of approximately 8 or more discrete lobes
Second neutrophil (center) with 5 nuclear lobes
Coarsely clumped chromatin in the lobes and pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Adjacent eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and orange-red granules for comparison
Red cells largely normochromic; mild anisocytosis without obvious schistocytes in this field
3894.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils and an eosinophil. One neutrophil displays marked nuclear hypersegmentation with approximately eight or more lobes, and a second neutrophil has five lobes. The eosinophil is morphologically unremarkable. Red cells in this field show mild anisocytosis; macro-ovalocytes are not prominent at this magnification. Findings are consistent with hypersegmented neutrophils, suggestive of megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: This rare autosomal dominant trait affects neutrophils without anemia, macrocytosis or low B12/folate levels.
Morphology is identical, so the distinction requires medication history and normal B12/folate levels.
MDS typically shows hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils and cytopenias with normal vitamin levels, rather than isolated hypersegmentation.
These occur with microcytic hypochromic red cells or renal failure and usually show only mild hypersegmentation.

2998.recognize_zh: 一顆大型細胞的細胞質塞滿粗大、黑褐色的顆粒（黑色素 melanin），甚至遮住細胞核；背景也有散在的細小深色色素顆粒，這種非造血性的色素細胞提示轉移性黑色素瘤。
features: Large single cell, many times the size of a red cell
Cytoplasm packed with coarse black-brown pigment granules of varying size obscuring the nucleus
Partially visible nucleus with reddish-purple chromatin
Fine dark pigment granules scattered in the background among red cells
Small adjacent lymphocyte for size comparison
2998.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered red cells with fine dark granular pigment in the background. A large cell contains abundant cytoplasm densely filled with coarse black-brown granules that partly obscure the nucleus. The granules are much coarser and darker than basophil or mast cell granules. Findings are suggestive of melanin-containing cells, consistent with metastatic melanoma in the appropriate context; distinction from a melanophage and confirmation require SOX10, S100, HMB-45 or Melan-A immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is golden-brown to blue-green and stains with Prussian blue, whereas melanin is black-brown and Prussian blue negative (Fontana-Masson positive).
Mast cell granules are uniform, purple-black and metachromatic, filling a round-oval cell, and the cell expresses tryptase and CD117.
A macrophage that has ingested melanin has a bland histiocytic nucleus and is negative for SOX10/Melan-A, while melanoma cells show nuclear atypia and melanocytic markers.
Basophils are small granulocytes with a segmented nucleus and dark purple water-soluble granules, far smaller than this cell.

1974.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞內充滿粗大、深紫黑色、大小不一的嗜鹼性顆粒，顆粒覆蓋並遮蔽細胞核，細胞周邊顆粒排列最明顯，旁邊的帶狀嗜中性球顆粒細小，對照可認出這是嗜鹼性前驅細胞（basophilic myelocyte）。
features: Medium-to-large cell (arrow) packed with coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules of variable size
Granules overlie and partly obscure a round nucleus; granules are most discrete at the cell periphery
Nucleus round, non-segmented, consistent with an immature (myelocyte-stage) basophil
Adjacent band/metamyelocyte neutrophils with fine granules for comparison
Background of scattered free granules from ruptured cells and marrow precursors
1974.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a granulocytic precursor (arrow) with a round, non-segmented nucleus densely overlaid by coarse, dark purple-black granules of variable size. Adjacent neutrophilic band forms and metamyelocytes contain only fine granules. Scattered free granules are present in the background, likely from disrupted cells. Findings are consistent with a basophilic precursor (basophilic myelocyte).

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger and round-to-spindle with a central nucleus and uniform, tightly packed granules that fill the cytoplasm evenly, whereas basophil granules are larger, fewer, and more variable, overlying a lobulating nucleus in mature forms.
Promyelocyte granules are reddish-purple azurophilic granules with a perinuclear Golgi hof, not black-purple granules overlying the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Eosinophilic precursor with immature basophilic-staining granules
ddx.vs: Early eosinophil granules may stain dark but are uniform, round, and accompanied by orange-red mature granules, unlike the irregular black-purple granules here.

1718.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團四顆彼此黏在一起的大細胞，核呈卵圓形、染色質細緻，共享大片淡藍色細胞質，體積遠大於周圍的造血細胞，屬於非造血來源的外來細胞（extrinsic cells）群聚。
features: Cohesive cluster of four large non-hematopoietic cells, several times the size of surrounding leukocytes
Large oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders (syncytial appearance)
Cells arranged as a tight aggregate rather than dispersed singly
Background of clumped red cells and small hematopoietic cells, mostly lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
1718.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders, clearly distinct from the surrounding small hematopoietic cells. The cells lack the granules of myeloid cells and the lobulated nucleus of megakaryocytes. Striking nuclear pleomorphism is not evident in this field, so benign non-hematopoietic elements cannot be fully excluded from this image alone. Findings represent extrinsic (non-hematopoietic) cells; correlation with the biopsy and cytokeratin/other immunostains is needed to exclude metastatic tumor.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters typically show nuclear pleomorphism, nuclear molding, prominent nucleoli and cytokeratin positivity.
Osteoblasts have eccentric round nuclei with a perinuclear hof away from the nucleus and occur in loose rows, often in children or reparative marrow.

ddx.dx: Endothelial/stromal cells from a capillary fragment
ddx.vs: Benign stromal fragments show elongated spindle nuclei in a linear or branching arrangement without atypia.
A megakaryocyte has a single multilobulated nucleus with pink granular cytoplasm rather than several separate oval nuclei.

2934.recognize_zh: 此視野只見三顆正常分葉的嗜中性球與散在的單顆血小板，嗜中性球周圍並沒有血小板環繞，看不到血小板衛星現象；可能是作為對照的非 EDTA（如檸檬酸鈉）抗凝檢體抹片，與標題所述現象不符。
features: Three segmented neutrophils with normal nuclear lobation and cytoplasm
Platelets present as scattered single forms and occasional doublets, adequate in number
No platelets adherent to or rosetting around neutrophils
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without schistocytes or significant poikilocytosis
No large platelet clumps identified in this field
2934.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells, three morphologically normal segmented neutrophils and adequate, evenly dispersed platelets, mostly single with occasional doublets. Notably, no platelets are adherent to the neutrophils and no platelet clumps are seen, so platelet satellitism is not demonstrated in this field. The image may represent a comparison smear from a non-EDTA (e.g., citrate) sample in which satellitism resolves, or a field away from the phenomenon. As shown, the image does not demonstrate platelet satellitism and is discordant with the title; it shows a normal peripheral smear with adequate platelets.

ddx.vs: Satellitism would show platelets rosetting around neutrophils with few free platelets, which is absent here.
Clumping would show aggregates of platelets, especially at the feathered edge, rather than evenly dispersed single platelets.

2614.recognize_zh: 組織切片中聚集許多上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），細胞質豐富淡粉紅、邊界不清，核呈橢圓形或鞋底狀、染色質淡，周圍夾雜小淋巴球，且看不到壞死，符合非乾酪性肉芽腫。
features: Aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval to elongated (slipper-shaped) nuclei with vesicular, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Numerous admixed small mature lymphocytes with dense round nuclei
No caseous necrosis identified in this field
Vacuolated, bubbly background, possibly processing artifact or admixed fat
2614.describe_en: Section shows a cellular aggregate composed of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, indistinct cell borders, and oval to elongated vesicular nuclei. Numerous small lymphocytes are intermixed. Necrosis is not identified, and multinucleated giant cells are not clearly seen in this field. Special stains for organisms are not shown. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing (non-caseating) granuloma, compatible with sarcoidosis in the appropriate clinical setting after exclusion of infection.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas often show central caseous necrosis and demonstrable organisms on AFB/GMS stains and culture, which must be excluded before diagnosing sarcoidosis.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells (CD30+, CD15+) within the mixed infiltrate, which are not seen here.
Lipogranulomas center on fat vacuoles with foamy macrophages and are small and paratrabecular-unrelated, rather than compact epithelioid aggregates.
Langerhans cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive.

1270.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一群中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣呈不規則毛狀突起，核圓至卵圓、染色質中等凝集，部分細胞可見單一小核仁，形態介於毛細胞與前淋巴球之間，符合毛細胞白血病變異型。
features: Cluster of medium-to-large lymphoid cells
Low to moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Irregular, ruffled cytoplasmic borders with fine hair-like projections
Round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Small but discernible single nucleolus in several cells
Background of normochromic red cells, some target-like, and scattered platelets
1270.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of medium to large lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and irregular, hairy cytoplasmic margins. The nuclei are round to oval with moderately condensed chromatin, and a small distinct nucleolus is visible in several cells. The combination of hairy cytoplasmic outlines with nucleolated, more condensed nuclei differs from classic hairy cell leukemia. Flow cytometry (CD11c+, CD103+, CD25-negative, CD123 weak/negative) and absence of BRAF V600E would support the diagnosis. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli).

ddx.vs: Classic hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with homogeneous, less condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus, and are CD25+/annexin A1+ with BRAF V600E.
SMZL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and short polar villi rather than abundant circumferential hairy cytoplasm, and are CD103-negative.
Prolymphocytes have a prominent nucleolus but scant cytoplasm with smooth borders lacking hairy projections.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules, and are CD14+.

1206.recognize_zh: 組織中血管壁呈同心圓增厚，並有許多無細胞的橘紅色（salmon pink）無定形沉積物分佈於血管壁與間質，是剛果紅（Congo red）染色下類澱粉沉積的表現。
features: Amorphous, acellular salmon-pink to orange-red deposits (congophilic material)
Circumferential thickening of small and medium vessel walls by congophilic deposits
Nodular globular deposits in the interstitium/stroma
Sparse background stromal cells with hematoxylin-stained nuclei; no inflammation
Polarization for apple-green birefringence is not shown in this bright-field image
1206.describe_en: Tissue section stained with Congo red shows extensive amorphous, acellular, salmon-pink to orange-red deposits within the walls of multiple small and medium-sized vessels, producing concentric mural thickening, and as globular deposits in the surrounding stroma. The background is paucicellular without significant inflammation. Confirmation requires apple-green birefringence under polarized light, which is not demonstrated in this bright-field image. Findings are consistent with amyloid deposition; in the setting of a plasma cell neoplasm, AL amyloidosis should be confirmed by typing (e.g., mass spectrometry or immunostaining for kappa/lambda).

ddx.vs: Hyaline arteriolosclerosis is Congo red negative and lacks apple-green birefringence under polarized light.
Monoclonal light chain deposits are Congo red negative and show linear granular deposits by immunofluorescence or electron microscopy rather than fibrils.
Collagen may stain faintly pink but is fibrillar and wavy and does not show apple-green birefringence with polarization.
Congo red cannot distinguish amyloid types; typing by mass spectrometry or immunohistochemistry is required.

1142.recognize_zh: 這張是 Wright 染色的骨髓抹片／切片印片，而非 H&E 切片；可見大片單一形態細胞，細胞質帶紫紅色顆粒、核呈卵圓或摺疊狀，正常造血細胞稀少，形態符合 APL 的異常前骨髓細胞。
features: Cellular preparation dominated by sheets of monotonous immature myeloid cells
Moderate cytoplasm with purple-red azurophilic granulation in many cells
Round to oval, some indented or folded nuclei with fine chromatin
Few residual mature granulocytes, lymphocytes and erythroid cells
Auer rods and faggot cells not resolved at this magnification
1142.describe_en: This Romanowsky-stained preparation (aspirate smear or biopsy touch imprint) shows sheets of monotonous immature myeloid cells with moderate cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules and round to folded nuclei with fine chromatin. Residual normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Although the title indicates a biopsy, the image is a cytologic preparation rather than a histologic section. Auer rods and bilobed butterfly nuclei cannot be confidently resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia in context; confirmation of PML::RARA is required.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation has agranular blasts with maturing granulocytes and usually lacks the CD34-/HLA-DR- hypergranular promyelocyte population and PML::RARA.
Regenerating promyelocytes are normal cells with a prominent Golgi zone and round nuclei that progressively mature, without faggot cells or PML::RARA.
Monocytic cells have gray vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules and are nonspecific esterase positive, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO positive with coarse granules.

1078.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞豐富，可見許多核偏位、細胞質藍色的漿細胞，部分細胞質隱約有紅紫色顆粒；此倍率下Snapper-Schneid顆粒不易看清，主要看出漿細胞增加。
features: Cellular aspirate with fat spaces and mixed hematopoietic elements at low power
Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Faint azurophilic granulation in some plasma cell cytoplasm, poorly resolved at this magnification
Admixed maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and small lymphocytes
1078.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is cellular with numerous fat spaces and mixed hematopoietic elements. Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm appear increased, and some show faint azurophilic cytoplasmic granulation, although granule detail is limited at this magnification. Maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors are present. Findings suggest a plasmacytosis with granulated plasma cells; higher-power review, plasma cell enumeration, and clonality studies are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature and polytypic by light-chain studies and usually below 10% of marrow cells.
Promyelocytes have central Golgi pallor, finer chromatin, and MPO-positive granules, distinguishable at high power.
LPL shows a prominent small lymphocyte and plasmacytoid lymphocyte component with MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.

4214.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被瀰漫性浸潤取代，細胞為中到大型、核膜不規則且有摺痕的異型淋巴球，夾雜較大的空泡狀核細胞；需配合 HTLV-1 血清學與 CD4+/CD25+ 表現型才能診斷成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse effacement by medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, indented and convoluted nuclear contours
Admixed larger cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Prominent extravasated red cells and small vessels in the background
4214.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse effacement of the architecture by a polymorphous infiltrate of medium-sized to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, indented to convoluted nuclei with coarse to vesicular chromatin, and a subset shows small nucleoli. Background contains abundant extravasated erythrocytes; no residual follicles are seen in this field. Morphology alone is not specific; in the setting of HTLV-1 seropositivity and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with nodal involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS can look identical and is separated by negative HTLV-1 serology/lack of clonally integrated HTLV-1 provirus.
AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13) on clear cells.
DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5-positive with round vesicular nuclei rather than CD3+/CD4+ convoluted T cells.

4150.recognize_zh: 小型退化的生發中心被層層同心圓排列的小淋巴球（洋蔥皮樣套區）包圍，並有玻璃樣變的小血管斜穿進入生發中心形成「棒棒糖」（lollipop）外觀，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型圖像。
features: Small atretic germinal center composed of follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells
Broad mantle zone with small lymphocytes in concentric onion-skin rings
Hyalinized vessel penetrating radially into the germinal center (lollipop sign)
Prominent small vessels with hyaline walls in the follicle periphery
Uniform small mature lymphocytes without atypia
4150.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a follicle with a small, regressed germinal center rich in follicular dendritic cells and vessels, surrounded by a markedly expanded mantle zone whose small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. A hyalinized vessel penetrates the germinal center, producing the characteristic lollipop appearance. No atypical lymphoid population is identified. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL mantles are formed by cyclin D1/SOX11-positive monoclonal cells rather than polyclonal small lymphocytes around atretic centers.
Regressive changes are focal and lack widespread onion-skinning, lollipop vessels and interfollicular hypervascularity.
HHV-8 MCD shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone.
FDC sarcoma forms fascicles and whorls of atypical CD21/CD23-positive spindle cells rather than preserved follicles.

3958.recognize_zh: 血片散布數個細長、兩端尖的鐮刀狀紅血球，並有多個含 Howell-Jolly 小體的紅血球、標靶細胞與多染性大紅血球，是鐮刀型貧血的典型表現。
features: Scattered elongated sickle cells with tapered ends
Numerous Howell-Jolly bodies (single small dark round inclusions) in red cells
Target cells and a few large polychromatophilic red cells
One red cell with multiple coarse basophilic inclusions (possible Pappenheimer bodies) at left
Occasional crenated/echinocytic cells; platelets adequate
3958.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with scattered sickle cells having elongated, pointed ends. Howell-Jolly bodies are frequent, and target cells and polychromatophilic macrocytes are present; one red cell contains multiple coarse basophilic inclusions suggestive of Pappenheimer bodies. A few crenated cells are also seen, and platelets are adequate. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with features of hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: HbSC has more target cells and blunt, crystal-bearing poikilocytes with fewer classic sickle cells; HPLC distinguishes them.
Sickle trait smears are essentially normal without sickle cells or Howell-Jolly bodies under standard conditions.
Sickle beta-thalassemia shows marked microcytosis and hypochromia with raised HbA2, whereas these cells are normochromic.
Asplenia explains Howell-Jolly and Pappenheimer bodies and target cells but does not produce sickle cells.

3830.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，三系造血間夾雜散在、細胞質淡粉紅且較透亮的大型組織球，是 Niemann-Pick 貯積細胞在切片上的樣子，但此倍率下泡沫質地不明顯。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and scattered fat spaces
Scattered large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm and small nuclei, interpreted as storage histiocytes
Histiocytes are interstitial and singly dispersed rather than forming large sheets in this field
Numerous small dark erythroid and lymphoid nuclei; megakaryocytes present
Foamy vacuolated cytoplasm not well resolved at this magnification
3830.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Interspersed among the hematopoietic elements are scattered large histiocytes with abundant pale, lightly eosinophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic vacuolation is not clearly resolved at this power, and no discrete sheets or granulomas are seen. In the context of the aspirate findings, the pale histiocytes are consistent with marrow involvement by Niemann-Pick disease; correlation with aspirate smears and enzymatic/genetic testing is required.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells on biopsy form sheets with striated, fibrillary pink cytoplasm, whereas Niemann-Pick cells are paler and foamy/vacuolated.
Mast cell aggregates are spindled, often paratrabecular/perivascular with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are CD117/tryptase positive.
Infection-related histiocytes tend to form granulomas and are confirmed by AFB/fungal stains rather than dispersed foamy cells.

3702.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高、脂肪空泡稀少，其中大量中型細胞核呈卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，成片分佈，夾雜少數深染圓核的紅血球系前驅細胞與一顆巨核細胞；這些未成熟細胞增多的區域，符合移植後急性骨髓性白血病（AML）復發。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with only a few small fat spaces
Sheets of medium-sized immature cells with oval to irregular or folded nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Scattered erythroid precursors with small round dark nuclei, and eosinophilic granulocytes
A single megakaryocyte with abundant pink cytoplasm and a mildly lobulated nucleus
Occasional mitotic figures; focal hemosiderin pigment
3702.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with scant residual fat. There are sheets of medium-sized immature mononuclear cells with oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with scattered erythroid precursors, eosinophilic granulocytes, occasional mitoses and a single megakaryocyte. Blast percentage cannot be precisely quantified on H&E alone. In the setting of prior stem cell transplant, findings are consistent with recurrent acute myeloid leukemia; CD34/CD117 immunohistochemistry, aspirate differential and chimerism studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows clusters of left-shifted but maturing myeloid and erythroid islands without sheets of CD34+ blasts.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in accelerated or blast phase
ddx.vs: CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1, which requires cytogenetic/molecular confirmation.
Donor-cell leukemia is morphologically identical and is distinguished by chimerism analysis showing donor origin.

3638.recognize_zh: 淋巴球的細胞核有一條條細溝紋與皺褶，看起來像腦迴（cerebriform），染色質緻密、細胞質很少；上方較大的一顆、右下較小的一顆都有核凹陷。這種腦迴狀核就是 Sézary 細胞的特徵。
features: Atypical lymphocytes with cerebriform nuclei showing fine grooves and folds
