Large Sézary cell variant (upper) with convoluted nucleus and a thin rim of pale-blue cytoplasm
Small Sézary cell variant (lower right) with an indented/notched, dense nucleus
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; scant agranular cytoplasm
Background RBCs with crenation (echinocytic artifact)
3638.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphocytes with cerebriform nuclei. The larger cell has a convoluted nucleus with fine grooves, condensed chromatin, and a narrow rim of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm, and a smaller cell shows an indented, hyperchromatic nucleus. The background red cells show crenation artifact. In the appropriate clinical setting of erythroderma, findings are consistent with circulating Sézary cells; flow cytometry for CD4+ T cells with loss of CD7/CD26 is recommended for quantification.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells have polylobated flower-like nuclei with deep clefts rather than fine cerebriform grooves, and HTLV-1 serology is positive.
T-PLL cells have a visible central nucleolus and basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, not grooved cerebriform nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and are few, while flow cytometry lacks a clonal CD4+CD7-/CD26- population.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Mantle cells can have notched nuclei but are B cells (CD5+, cyclin D1+) and lack the fine cerebriform grooving.

3574.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型顆粒球，核碎成多個不規則小葉（異常過度分葉），下方另一顆中性球核呈雙葉、細胞質淡而顆粒少（假性 Pelger 加低顆粒化）；兩種異常一起出現，指向顆粒球系發育不良。
features: Large granulocyte with abnormal multilobated/hypersegmented nucleus with irregular clumped lobes
Abundant cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Second neutrophil (lower center) with bilobed pseudo-Pelger nucleus and pale hypogranular cytoplasm
Scattered erythroid precursors and a megakaryocytic fragment/platelet clumps at the upper right
RBCs with refractile drying artifact; background with stain precipitate
3574.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large granulocyte with an abnormally multilobated nucleus of irregular, clumped lobes and finely granular cytoplasm. Below it, a neutrophil has a bilobed pseudo-Pelger nucleus and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors and platelet clumps are present at the edge, and red cells show drying artifact. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis; correlation with blast count, multilineage dysplasia, and cytogenetics is required to support myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmentation is accompanied by giant metamyelocytes and megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open chromatin, and granulation is preserved.
Growth factor therapy produces toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, and left shift with increased granules rather than hypogranularity.
The inherited anomaly shows uniformly bilobed neutrophils with normal granulation and no giant hypersegmented forms.

3446.recognize_zh: 中央一顆中性球細胞質內有數個清楚空泡，其中含淡紫色顆粒狀物，大小與血小板相當，代表吞噬血小板；背景可見少數棘狀紅血球與游離血小板。
features: Neutrophil with lobulated dark nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm
Two to three well-defined cytoplasmic vacuoles, one containing a pale granular platelet-sized body
Nucleus indented by the vacuoles
Background normochromic red cells with occasional echinocytes
Few free platelets and small platelet clumps in the field
3446.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with scattered echinocytes and a few small platelet clumps. A neutrophil contains several sharply defined phagocytic vacuoles indenting the nucleus, at least one of which encloses a pale granular body consistent with an ingested platelet. Findings are consistent with neutrophil phagocytosis of platelets.

ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are multiple small empty vacuoles often with toxic granulation, whereas these vacuoles contain platelet-like material.
Histoplasma yeasts are uniform 2–4 µm oval bodies with a crescent of purple chromatin and a clear halo, not pale granular platelet fragments.
Satellitism places platelets around the outside of the neutrophil membrane rather than within vacuoles.

3254.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，大部分細胞的細胞質充滿粗大、折光的橘紅色顆粒，核為雙葉或圓形（嗜酸性骨髓細胞），嗜酸性球系列明顯增加。
features: Numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes with coarse refractile orange-red granules
Bilobed nuclei in mature forms; round to indented nuclei in precursors
Some cells with admixed darker granules suggesting immature eosinophils
Scattered erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and occasional neutrophils
No compact mast cell aggregates or blast sheets in this field
3254.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow section (H&E) shows a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors with coarse, refractile orange-red cytoplasmic granules; mature forms have bilobed nuclei and precursors have round to indented nuclei. Erythroid precursors and neutrophils are present in smaller numbers, and no blast sheets or compact mast cell aggregates are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; the differential between reactive eosinophilia and a clonal eosinophilic neoplasm requires clinical and genetic correlation.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; FIP1L1::PDGFRA detection, elevated tryptase and loose CD25+ mast cells support the clonal diagnosis.
Mastocytosis shows dense spindled mast cell aggregates with CD117/tryptase/CD25 and KIT D816V.
Neutrophil precursors have fine pale pink-lilac granules, not coarse bright orange-red granules.
LCH shows eosinophils among sheets of CD1a/langerin-positive cells with grooved coffee-bean nuclei.

3126.recognize_zh: 組織切片中，脂肪空隙之間由密集成片的漿細胞取代正常造血，細胞核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀並有核周淡染區，符合骨髓廣泛漿細胞浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous plasmacytoid cells replacing marrow between fat spaces
Round eccentric nuclei with clumped, cartwheel-like chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing (hof)
Paucity of normal trilineage hematopoiesis
Nuclear detail limited by section thickness and magnification
3126.describe_en: Bone marrow section shows diffuse, packed sheets of plasma cells occupying the intertrabecular space between residual adipocytes. The cells have round eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing. Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate peripheral blood context; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are recommended to confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: LPL has a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and mast cells with CD20-positive B cells rather than pure plasma cell sheets.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows a predominant CD20-positive B-cell population with nodular or intrasinusoidal pattern and only a minor plasma cell component.
Reactive plasma cells are interstitial and perivascular, not in sheets, and are polytypic.

2870.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞明顯變大，核染色質呈細緻開放的篩網狀（megaloblastic chromatin），細胞質已見血紅素化但核仍不成熟（核質發育不同步），並可見大型骨髓系細胞。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with finely dispersed, open sieve-like chromatin
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: polychromatic cytoplasm with immature-appearing nuclei
Deeply basophilic early megaloblasts with abundant cytoplasm
Occasional erythroid nuclear irregularity/lobulation
Large granulocytic precursors with open chromatin; eosinophil myelocyte present
2870.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid hyperplasia with megaloblastic change. Erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely dispersed, open chromatin that persists into polychromatic stages, producing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, and some show nuclear irregularity. Granulocytic precursors are also enlarged. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, in this clinical context attributable to the antifolate drug pyrimethamine.

ddx.vs: MDS shows megaloblastoid erythroids with additional multilineage dysplasia (pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes, ring sideroblasts) and normal B12/folate.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥30% proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, not a full spectrum of maturing megaloblasts.
CDA features prominent binucleation, internuclear bridges and characteristic EM findings without drug or vitamin deficiency history.

2806.recognize_zh: 數顆大型母細胞染色質細緻、細胞質淡藍，右下一顆細胞質較多呈灰藍色、偏向單核母細胞樣，左上另有一顆成熟中性球；混合原始細胞形態可提示急性骨髓單核球性白血病，但需細胞化學確認。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Round to oval nuclei; one cell with a slightly irregular contour
Lower-right blast with more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, suggestive of monocytic differentiation
No Auer rods or obvious cytoplasmic granules in the blasts
A segmented neutrophil with granular cytoplasm at upper left; red cells unremarkable
2806.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, indistinct nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods. One blast has more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, raising the possibility of monocytic differentiation, and a mature segmented neutrophil is present nearby. The monocytic and granulocytic components cannot be quantified from this field. Findings indicate circulating blasts and are compatible with acute myelomonocytic leukemia when supported by NSE/MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation has >=10% maturing neutrophil-lineage cells but <20% monocytic cells, confirmed by NSE negativity and lack of CD14/CD64 expression.
Acute monocytic leukemia has >=80% monocytic cells with prominent folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm and minimal neutrophil lineage.
ALL blasts are MPO/NSE-negative and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
This genetic entity often has myelomonocytic morphology plus abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules and requires cytogenetic confirmation.

2742.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆中型淋巴細胞，細胞質少而偏嗜鹼性，核圓至不規則、部分有凹陷，染色質中度凝集並隱約可見核仁；右側一顆細胞核呈腎形凹陷，符合 T 前淋巴球（T-PLL）的形態。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, about 1.5 times a red cell diameter
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round to irregular nuclei, one with a prominent indentation (reniform)
Moderately condensed chromatin with an indistinct nucleolus in some cells
Subtle irregular cytoplasmic outlines; background red cells unremarkable
2742.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei including one with a distinct indentation, moderately condensed chromatin and small, indistinct nucleoli. Red cells are unremarkable. The cells are larger and less mature-appearing than normal small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate context; flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform, convoluted nuclei and lack strong CD7, whereas T-PLL cells have round to indented nuclei with a nucleolus and are TCL1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, rather than a monotonous basophilic population.
Leukemic MCL cells can have indented nuclei but are CD5+ B cells with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
ATLL cells show polylobated flower-like nuclei and are CD25+ with HTLV-1 infection.

2678.recognize_zh: 中央四顆細胞約為紅血球的 1.5–2 倍大，核質比極高，只有一圈很薄的淡藍細胞質，染色質細緻，部分可見小核仁，細胞質無顆粒也無 Auer rod；這種小型均一的母細胞符合急性淋巴性白血病（ALL）。
features: Four small-to-medium blasts, about 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with scant rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin
Small or indistinct nucleoli in some cells
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods; background normochromic red cells without other leukocytes
2678.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of four blasts that are small to medium in size with a very high N:C ratio and a scant rim of agranular pale basophilic cytoplasm. Nuclei are round with finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin and small, inconspicuous nucleoli. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are absent. Background red cells are normochromic, and no maturing granulocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts suggestive of acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry is required to confirm lymphoid lineage (B versus T) and exclude minimally differentiated AML.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and may contain granules or Auer rods; confirm by MPO and flow cytometry.
Hematogones are mainly in marrow of children or regenerating marrow, have homogeneous condensed chromatin, and show a normal maturation spectrum on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mature lymphoma (e.g., mantle cell, CLL)
ddx.vs: Mature lymphoma cells have more condensed chromatin, possible nuclear clefts and smudge cells, and are TdT/CD34-negative.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and multiple nucleoli.

2486.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多中大型、核摺疊或腎形、胞質灰藍帶細顆粒的單核球與前單核球，夾雜小淋巴球、有核紅血球與顆粒球前驅細胞，呈現骨髓單核球系增生而原始細胞未成片，符合 JMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with increased monocytic cells
Monocytes and promonocytes with folded, indented or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant grey-blue finely granular cytoplasm
Occasional cells with delicate chromatin and nucleoli (blasts), not forming sheets
Admixed granulocytic precursors, small lymphocytes and dense erythroid precursors
Background red cells with rouleaux-free distribution
2486.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular, mixed population with a conspicuous increase in monocytic cells, including monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm. Occasional blasts are present, admixed with maturing granulocytes, small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors. There are no sheets of blasts. Findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in a child with peripheral monocytosis, splenomegaly and a RAS-pathway mutation; blasts plus promonocytes should be enumerated to exclude AML.

ddx.vs: AML with monocytic differentiation shows >=20% monoblasts and promonocytes forming sheets with little maturing background.
CMML is morphologically similar but is an adult disease without the pediatric JMML genetic context.
Reactive monocytes are mature without promonocytes or blasts, and the disorder resolves with the underlying cause.

2102.recognize_zh: 這是 inverse PCR 洋菜膠電泳圖，非形態學影像：移植前檢體（lane 1–3）在約 234 bp 處可見代表主要 ATL 克隆的 HTLV-1 前病毒整合位點條帶，移植後檢體（lane 4–6）完全無條帶，表示克隆偵測不到。
features: Agarose gel electrophoresis of inverse PCR for HTLV-1 proviral integration sites
Lanes 1-3 (before BMT) show discrete bands, with the major clone band at approximately 234 bp
Lanes 1 and 3 show additional larger bands (about 300-400 bp), indicating additional integration sites or minor clones
Lanes 4-6 (after BMT) show no amplified bands
Size ladder on right spanning 194 to 1353 bp
2102.describe_en: This figure is an ethidium bromide-stained agarose gel of inverse PCR detecting HTLV-1 proviral integration sites as a marker of the ATL cell clone. Pre-transplant samples (lanes 1-3) show discrete bands, with a major clone band at approximately 234 bp and additional bands in the 300-400 bp range, indicating clonal integration of the provirus. Post-transplant samples (lanes 4-6) show no detectable bands, consistent with eradication of the ATL clone below the assay detection limit after bone marrow transplantation. This is molecular data without morphologic content; absence of bands should be interpreted in light of assay sensitivity and DNA quality controls.

2038.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面暗紅色，佈滿無數大小一致、約 1–2 mm 的灰白至黃白色小結節，像撒了小米一樣（miliary pattern），這是粟粒性分枝桿菌感染（miliary tuberculosis）在脾臟的肉眼表現。
features: Gross cut surface of spleen with dark red congested parenchyma
Innumerable small, uniform, discrete pale tan-white nodules (about 1-2 mm)
Diffuse, evenly distributed miliary pattern throughout the section
No large confluent mass or dominant tumor nodule
Specimen label present at left edge
2038.describe_en: Gross photograph of the cut surface of the spleen shows dark red parenchyma diffusely studded with innumerable small, uniform, pale tan-white nodules measuring roughly 1-2 mm. No large confluent mass is identified. The miliary distribution suggests hematogenous dissemination. Findings are consistent with miliary mycobacterial infection involving the spleen, with histology and acid-fast staining or culture required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Fungal abscesses and granulomas can mimic miliary nodules grossly, and are separated by GMS/PAS stains showing yeasts or hyphae rather than acid-fast bacilli.
Sarcoid produces similar small nodules composed of non-necrotizing granulomas with negative AFB and fungal stains and appropriate clinical context.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by lymphoma (miliary white pulp pattern)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma such as SMZL or Hodgkin lymphoma expands the white pulp into nodules that are lymphoid on histology, without granulomas or caseation.

1846.recognize_zh: 視野內幾乎都是中型芽細胞，核圓或有切跡、染色質細緻、細胞質少量淡藍且無顆粒，偶見較小而染色質較深的細胞，右下有一顆含空泡的巨噬細胞；這種單一族群且無顆粒的芽細胞提示淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Predominant intermediate-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round, oval or notched nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli small or inconspicuous
Admixed smaller cells with more condensed chromatin
No Auer rods or granules in the blast population
Occasional vacuolated macrophage (lower right) and smeared cell strands in the background
1846.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is largely replaced by intermediate-sized blasts with high N:C ratios, round to notched nuclei, fine chromatin and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm. Nucleoli are small or inconspicuous and no Auer rods are seen. Scattered smaller cells with condensed chromatin and an occasional vacuolated macrophage are present. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, pending immunophenotypic confirmation of B lineage.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated morphologically; cytoplasmic CD3 expression by flow cytometry defines T lineage.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Blasts may have more cytoplasm and occasional Auer rods, and show MPO positivity or myeloid antigen expression rather than CD19/CD10/CD79a.
TdT-negative with surface light chain restriction, CD5 and cyclin D1 positivity.
Hematogones are a minor population with homogeneous condensed chromatin and a normal maturational antigen continuum by flow.

1782.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆小型成熟淋巴球，核濃縮、細胞質淡藍，在核的左下緣可見一顆單獨、邊界清楚的紫紅色大顆粒；淋巴球出現這種異常巨大的嗜天青顆粒，是 Chediak-Higashi 異常的線索之一，但單一顆粒不具專一性。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with round nucleus and condensed chromatin
Thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Single discrete, round, magenta-purple granule at the lower left nuclear margin, larger than normal azurophilic granules
Surrounding normocytic, normochromic red cells
No other leukocytes available in the field for comparison
1782.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte with condensed nuclear chromatin and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm. A single discrete, round, magenta-purple cytoplasmic granule, larger than typical azurophilic granules, is present at the nuclear margin. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. In the proper clinical setting (partial oculocutaneous albinism, recurrent pyogenic infections), this giant azurophilic granule is compatible with Chediak-Higashi abnormality; the finding should be confirmed by identifying giant granules in neutrophils and other leukocytes, and LYST mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Has more abundant cytoplasm with several fine to coarse azurophilic granules of normal size, not a single giant granule.
Dense purple mucopolysaccharide granules are present in all leukocyte types, including numerous granules in lymphocytes, rather than one giant granule.
A platelet has a pale hyalomere with a granular center and lies outside the cell border or focal plane.
Occur in dysplastic myeloid cells and blasts of a neoplastic disorder rather than in otherwise normal lymphocytes.

1590.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆與中性球大小相近的細胞，細胞內佈滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，覆蓋在核上使核輪廓幾乎看不清，這是嗜鹼性球（basophil）最典型的辨識線索。
features: Cell slightly larger than a red cell, similar in size to a neutrophil
Numerous coarse, dark purple-black granules distributed over the cytoplasm and nucleus
Nuclear outline largely obscured by overlying granules
Granules extend to the cell periphery giving a slightly irregular border
Background red cells show fine dark dots, most likely a staining/drying artifact
1590.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single basophil with abundant coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus and extend to the cell margin. The surrounding red cells are normocytic with fine dark dots that most likely represent a preparation artifact. No blasts or other abnormal leukocytes are present in the field. Findings are consistent with a normal basophil.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus that remains visible and are rarely seen in blood outside systemic mastocytosis or mast cell leukemia.
Toxic granulation consists of dark granules in a neutrophil whose lobated nucleus remains clearly visible, often with Döhle bodies or vacuoles.
Eosinophils contain uniform refractile orange-red granules with a visible bilobed nucleus rather than dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus.

118.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中 FLAER/CD24 雙陰性的顆粒球占 97%、FLAER/CD14 雙陰性的單核球占 94.5%，紅血球 CD59 出現完全缺失（type III 40.4%）族群，這是 GPI 錨定蛋白缺失的大型 PNH clone；骨髓則呈紅血球系增生，符合溶血。
features: Flow: granulocytes gated on SSC vs CD15 show 97.03% FLAER-negative/CD24-negative PNH cells
Flow: monocytes gated on SSC vs CD64 show 94.54% FLAER-negative/CD14-negative PNH cells
Flow: red cells show CD59 type I 57.66%, type II 1.93% and type III (complete deficiency) 40.42%
Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy: hypercellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia, including clusters of erythroid precursors with open chromatin and mitoses; megakaryocytes present
CD34 IHC highlights vessels only, with rare positive cells and no increase in blasts
Peripheral blood: polychromatophilic macrocytes, occasional spherocytes and small red cell clumps (arrows) on a low-power smear
118.describe_en: High-sensitivity flow cytometry demonstrates a large PNH clone: 97.03% of gated granulocytes lack FLAER and CD24, 94.54% of gated monocytes lack FLAER and CD14, and red cells show 40.42% type III (complete CD59 loss) and 1.93% type II (partial loss) populations. The lower red cell clone size relative to granulocytes is expected with ongoing hemolysis of complement-sensitive type III cells and/or transfusion. The bone marrow aspirate and core biopsy are hypercellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia and preserved megakaryocytes; CD34 immunostain highlights vessels without increased blasts. The peripheral blood smear shows polychromasia and red cell anisocytosis with small red cell clumps. Findings are consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria with a large clone; morphology alone is nonspecific and the diagnosis rests on the flow cytometric GPI-anchor deficiency.

ddx.vs: AIHA shows spherocytes and DAT positivity but granulocytes and monocytes retain FLAER and GPI-linked antigens, and red cells lack a CD59 type III population.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with a small PNH clone
ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow with a small (often <10%) GPI-deficient population, whereas this marrow is hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia and a clone >90% of granulocytes.
MDS may show erythroid hyperplasia but with dysplasia and cytogenetic abnormalities; GPI-deficient clones are small or absent.

ddx.dx: Congenital CD59 deficiency or CD55 (Inab) deficiency
ddx.vs: Isolated inherited deficiency affects a single antigen on all cells, whereas PNH shows loss of multiple GPI-linked proteins and FLAER binding in a clonal subset of cells.

captions: Flow: SSC vs CD64 gating of granulocytes, lymphocytes and monocytes
Bone marrow aspirate: erythroid hyperplasia with numerous erythroid precursors and mixed myeloid cells
Bone marrow aspirate: erythroid precursors, platelet clumps and scattered myeloid cells
Flow: SSC vs CD15 gating of granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes
Flow: FS vs SS gating of red blood cells
Flow: red cell CD59 expression, type I 57.66%, type II 1.93%, type III 40.42%
Peripheral blood, low power: small red cell clumps (arrows) with few leukocytes
Peripheral blood, high power: polychromatophilic macrocytes, anisocytosis and occasional spherocytes
Bone marrow biopsy H&E: hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia (arrow) adjacent to trabecular bone
Bone marrow biopsy H&E, high power: erythroid precursor clusters with mitoses and megakaryocytes
CD34 IHC: vessels highlighted, rare positive cell (arrow), no increase in blasts

54.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結副皮質與竇內可見淡粉紅色、片狀的組織球樣細胞浸潤，中間夾雜嗜酸性球；高倍下細胞具咖啡豆狀核溝（nuclear grooves）與淡嗜酸性胞質，免疫染色 S100、CD1a 與 langerin 陽性且避開濾泡，符合淋巴結蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）。
features: Pale eosinophilic sheets and nodules of histiocytoid cells expanding paracortex and sinuses, sparing residual lymphoid follicles
Medium-to-large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Oval, folded to reniform nuclei with longitudinal grooves (coffee-bean nuclei), fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous admixed eosinophils around the lesional cell aggregates
Lesional cells strongly positive for S100 (nuclear and cytoplasmic), membranous CD1a and granular cytoplasmic langerin (unlabeled IHC panels)
54.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show partial effacement by pale eosinophilic sheets and nodules of histiocytoid cells that expand the paracortex and sinuses and surround residual lymphoid follicles, with focal hemorrhage. At high power the lesional cells have abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, folded or grooved (coffee-bean) nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, accompanied by numerous eosinophils; no significant pleomorphism is seen. Immunohistochemical stains (panels unlabeled) show the lesional cells to be diffusely positive with a nuclear/cytoplasmic pattern consistent with S100, a crisp membranous pattern consistent with CD1a, and a granular cytoplasmic pattern consistent with langerin, sparing the follicles. Findings are consistent with nodal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive Langerhans cells are confined to nodular paracortical expansions with interdigitating dendritic cells and melanin-laden macrophages, without sinus-filling sheets or conspicuous eosinophil clusters.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are large with round nuclei, visible nucleoli and emperipolesis, are S100+ but CD1a- and langerin-negative, and are accompanied by plasma cells rather than eosinophils.
Langerhans cell sarcoma shows overtly malignant cytology with marked pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli and brisk mitoses, unlike the bland grooved nuclei seen here.
cHL has CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background, whereas the grooved histiocytoid cells here are CD1a+/langerin+.

54.stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled, likely S100, CD1a, langerin)
captions: H&E, low power: pale eosinophilic sheets of histiocytoid cells expanding paracortex and sinuses around residual follicles
H&E, medium power: sheet of pale grooved Langerhans cells adjacent to a residual lymphoid follicle
H&E, high power: Langerhans cells with grooved coffee-bean nuclei admixed with numerous eosinophils
IHC (nuclear and cytoplasmic pattern, likely S100): diffuse positivity of lesional cells
IHC (membranous pattern, likely CD1a), low power: interconnected sheets of positive cells sparing follicles

62774.recognize_zh: 四格末梢血中的分葉中性球細胞質裡可見淡藍色、邊界模糊的大塊包涵體（類似 Döhle body，但無感染時的毒性顆粒），同時視野中有接近紅血球大小的巨大血小板；在血小板低下的孩童，這樣的組合要想到 MYH9 相關疾病（May-Hegglin 異常）。
features: Mature segmented neutrophils with pale blue, ill-defined cytoplasmic inclusions (Döhle-like bodies), best seen in panels C and D
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal without toxic granulation or vacuolization
Giant platelet approaching red cell size (panel C, lower field); other platelets small and sparse, consistent with thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
Image resolution limits fine assessment of inclusion shape
62774.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows segmented neutrophils containing pale blue, poorly demarcated cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Döhle bodies, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolization. Platelets appear decreased, and at least one giant platelet approaching the size of a red cell is present. Red cell morphology is unremarkable. In a pediatric patient with thrombocytopenia, the combination of Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions and macrothrombocytes is suggestive of an MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly); confirmation by NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence or MYH9 genetic testing is recommended to avoid misdiagnosis as immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: ITP may have mildly enlarged platelets but neutrophils lack Döhle-like inclusions, and platelet size is not uniformly giant.
Reactive Döhle bodies are smaller, peripheral, and accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuoles, without giant platelets or chronic thrombocytopenia.
Bernard-Soulier has giant platelets but normal neutrophils, and platelets fail to agglutinate with ristocetin due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant coarse azurophilic/peroxidase-positive granules in granulocytes rather than pale blue amorphous inclusions.

1334.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中箭頭所指的血管壁被一層層無細胞、淡粉紅色、均質蠟樣的物質增厚，管腔變窄；這種血管壁無定形嗜酸性沉積就是類澱粉（amyloid），在類澱粉沉積症中可吸附第十凝血因子而造成後天性 factor X 缺乏。
features: Blood vessel with markedly thickened wall replaced by acellular, homogeneous, pale eosinophilic material (arrows)
Lamellated, waxy appearance of the deposit with narrowed lumen
Additional smaller vessel with similar hyaline wall deposition at the top
Adjacent bony trabecula and cellular marrow with maturing hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes
No obvious plasma cell sheets in this field
1334.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a medium-sized blood vessel whose wall is markedly thickened and replaced by acellular, homogeneous, waxy pale eosinophilic material, with narrowing of the lumen; a second smaller vessel shows similar deposition. The adjacent marrow is cellular with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis, and no plasma cell sheets are seen in this field. Confirmation requires Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence under polarized light, and amyloid typing (e.g., mass spectrometry). Findings are suggestive of vascular amyloid deposition, consistent with systemic AL amyloidosis in the setting of acquired factor X deficiency.

ddx.vs: Seen in hypertension, diabetes, and aging, with homogeneous hyaline walls that are Congo red negative without apple-green birefringence.
Consists of pale extracellular mucopolysaccharide in the interstitium, Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative, rather than vessel wall deposits.
Deposits are Congo red negative and non-fibrillary, with granular deposits on electron microscopy.
Shows brightly eosinophilic fibrin with inflammatory cells and karyorrhexis in the wall, not bland lamellated deposits.
